## File: `README.md`

```markdown
# Arshith Fresh - Full Stack Architecture (HTML/CSS Frontend + MongoDB Backend)

A complete, clean e-commerce platform for **Arshith Fresh**.

---

## 📁 Complete Clean Directory Structure

```text
folder3/
│
├── 📂 backend/                   # Complete MongoDB Database & REST API Layer
│   ├── 📂 config/
│   │   └── db.js                 # Self-hosted MongoDB connection (Mongoose)
│   ├── 📂 models/                # Database Schemas
│   │   ├── Product.js            # Product Schema (Oils, Spices, Ghee, Seeds, etc.)
│   │   ├── User.js               # Customer & Admin User accounts
│   │   ├── Order.js              # Checkout orders & status tracking
│   │   └── Collection.js         # Category collections
│   ├── 📂 routes/                # REST API Endpoints
│   │   ├── productRoutes.js      # /api/products (CRUD)
│   │   ├── orderRoutes.js        # /api/orders (Checkout & Admin)
│   │   ├── userRoutes.js         # /api/users (Login & Registration)
│   │   └── collectionRoutes.js   # /api/collections
│   ├── .env                      # Database URI & Port (mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/arshith_fresh)
│   ├── seed.js                   # Starter database seeder (populates MongoDB with sample items)
│   ├── server.js                 # Express API server entry point
│   └── package.json              # Backend dependencies (express, mongoose, cors, dotenv)
│
├── 📂 admin/                     # Admin Portal (Clean HTML Pages)
│   ├── dashboard.html            # Main Admin dashboard & analytics
│   ├── products.html             # Product stock & catalog manager
│   ├── product-detail.html       # Add / Edit product
│   ├── orders.html               # Orders list & tracking
│   ├── collections.html          # Category manager
│   ├── inventory.html            # SKU & variant tracking
│   ├── customers.html            # Customer accounts
│   └── login.html                # Admin authentication
│
├── 📂 assets/                    # Shared Static Assets
│   ├── css/                      # Centralized, modular stylesheets
│   │   ├── style.css             # Main storefront styling
│   │   ├── admin.css             # Unified Admin portal styling
│   │   ├── auth.css              # Login & registration styling
│   │   ├── cart.css              # Cart & checkout styling
│   │   └── pages.css             # Subpages & policy styling
│   ├── js/

│   └── images/
│       └── banners/              # Category hero & promotional banners
│
├── 📂 pages/                     # Storefront Subpages
│   ├── categories/               # Product category pages (spices, oils, ghee, etc.)
│   ├── auth/                     # Customer account pages (login, register, forgot-password)
│   ├── policies/                 # Privacy, Refund, Shipping, Terms

│   ├── checkout.html             # Checkout flow

│   ├── product.html              # Product details page
│   ├── profile.html              # User account profile
│   ├── seller.html               # Seller onboarding

## 🚀 How to Run

### 1. Start Your MongoDB Backend API
Ensure your self-hosted MongoDB is running, then start the backend server:
```bash
cd backend
npm start
```
- API will run at **`http://localhost:5000/api`**.

### 2. Populate Initial Database Items (Optional)
To insert starter organic products, collections, and an admin account into MongoDB:
```bash
cd backend
npm run seed
```

### 3. Open the Frontend
- **Customer Store**: Open [index.html](file:///c:/Users/Phani%20Chand/OneDrive/Desktop/folder3/index.html) or run with Live Server.
- **Admin Dashboard**: Open [admin/dashboard.html](file:///c:/Users/Phani%20Chand/OneDrive/Desktop/folder3/admin/dashboard.html).

```

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <script>window.location.replace('dashboard.html');</script>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Financial Reports & Analytics - Arshith Fresh Admin</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../assets/css/admin.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>

  <style>
    .finance-kpi-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .finance-kpi-card {
      background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #e1e3e5);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px);
      padding: 18px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
      transition: transform .15s, box-shadow .15s;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .finance-kpi-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.07); }
    .finance-kpi-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .finance-kpi-title { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #64748b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .5px; }
    .finance-kpi-icon-box { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 18px; }
    .kpi-green  { background: #e8f5e9; color: #0f7139; }
    .kpi-blue   { background: #e0f2fe; color: #0284c7; }
    .kpi-purple { background: #f3e8ff; color: #9333ea; }
    .kpi-amber  { background: #fef3c7; color: #d97706; }
    .kpi-red    { background: #fee2e2; color: #dc2626; }
    .kpi-teal   { background: #ccfbf1; color: #0d9488; }
    .finance-kpi-value { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; color: #1e293b; line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .finance-kpi-sub { font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
    .badge-live { color: #15803d; background: #dcfce7; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; }

    /* Two chart grid layouts */
    .chart-grid-2-1 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
    .chart-grid-1-1 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
    .chart-grid-3   { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
    @media (max-width: 1100px) {
      .chart-grid-2-1, .chart-grid-1-1, .chart-grid-3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    /* Card */
    .analytics-card {
      background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #e1e3e5);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px);
      box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
      padding: 20px 22px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .analytics-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }
    .analytics-card-title { font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .chart-canvas-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 280px; }

    /* Timeframe pills */
    .tf-pills { display: flex; gap: 5px; background: #f1f5f9; padding: 3px; border-radius: 8px; }
    .tf-btn { background: none; border: none; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #64748b; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; }
    .tf-btn.active { background: #fff; color: #0f7139; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.1); }

    /* Leaderboard */
    .leaderboard-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .leader-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 12px; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #f1f5f9; border-radius: 8px; transition: background .15s; }
    .leader-item:hover { background: #f0fdf4; border-color: #bbf7d0; }
    .leader-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .leader-rank { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; background: #e2e8f0; color: #475569; }
    .rank-gold { background: #fef08a; color: #854d0e; }
    .rank-silver { background: #e2e8f0; color: #334155; }
    .rank-bronze { background: #fed7aa; color: #9a3412; }
    .leader-thumb { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 6px; object-fit: cover; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; }
    .leader-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .leader-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; max-width: 180px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .leader-meta { font-size: 11.5px; color: #64748b; }
    .leader-right { text-align: right; }
    .leader-revenue { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f7139; }
    .leader-units { font-size: 11.5px; color: #64748b; }

    /* Status pills */
    .status-pill { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
    .sp-delivered { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; }
    .sp-placed, .sp-confirmed, .sp-dispatched { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }
    .sp-cancelled { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; }
    .sp-default { background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; }

    /* Alert banner */
    .data-note { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #eff6ff; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 13px; color: #1d4ed8; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  </style>
</head>

          <div class="finance-kpi-top">
            <span class="finance-kpi-title">Total Orders Placed</span>
            <div class="finance-kpi-icon-box kpi-blue"><i class="fa-solid fa-bag-shopping"></i></div>
          </div>
          <div class="finance-kpi-value" id="kOrders">—</div>
          <div class="finance-kpi-sub"><span id="kDelivered" style="font-weight:700;color:#0f7139;">—</span>&nbsp;delivered &nbsp;·&nbsp; <span id="kDeliveryRate" style="color:#64748b;">—</span> rate</div>
        </div>


        <div class="finance-kpi-card">
          <div class="finance-kpi-top">
            <span class="finance-kpi-title">Discounts Given</span>
            <div class="finance-kpi-icon-box kpi-red"><i class="fa-solid fa-tag"></i></div>
          </div>
          <div class="finance-kpi-value" id="kDiscount">—</div>
          <div class="finance-kpi-sub"><span id="kCoupons" style="font-weight:700;color:#dc2626;">—</span>&nbsp;coupons active</div>
        </div>

        <div class="finance-kpi-card">
          <div class="finance-kpi-top">
            <span class="finance-kpi-title">Catalog Inventory Value</span>
            <div class="finance-kpi-icon-box kpi-amber"><i class="fa-solid fa-boxes-stacked"></i></div>
          </div>
          <div class="finance-kpi-value" id="kInventory">—</div>
          <div class="finance-kpi-sub"><span id="kProducts" style="font-weight:700;color:#d97706;">—</span>&nbsp;products, <span id="kCollections" style="font-weight:600;">—</span>&nbsp;categories</div>
        </div>

        <div class="finance-kpi-card">
          <div class="finance-kpi-top">
            <span class="finance-kpi-title">Total Customers</span>
            <div class="finance-kpi-icon-box kpi-teal"><i class="fa-solid fa-users"></i></div>
          </div>
          <div class="finance-kpi-value" id="kCustomers">—</div>
          <div class="finance-kpi-sub"><span id="kTopCustomer" style="font-weight:700;color:#0d9488;">—</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ═══════════ ROW 2: Revenue Timeline + Category Doughnut ═══════════ -->
      <div class="chart-grid-2-1">
        <div class="analytics-card">
          <div class="analytics-card-header">
            <div class="analytics-card-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-chart-line" style="color:#0f7139;"></i> Revenue Earned & Orders Over Time</div>
            <div class="tf-pills">
              <button class="tf-btn" onclick="setTF('7d',this)">7 Days</button>
              <button class="tf-btn" onclick="setTF('30d',this)">30 Days</button>
              <button class="tf-btn active" onclick="setTF('all',this)">All Time</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="chart-canvas-wrap"><canvas id="chartTimeline"></canvas></div>
        </div>

        <div class="analytics-card">
          <div class="analytics-card-header">
            <div class="analytics-card-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-chart-pie" style="color:#7c3aed;"></i> Revenue by Category</div>
            <span id="catCount" style="font-size:12px;color:#64748b;font-weight:600;"></span>
          </div>
          <div class="chart-canvas-wrap"><canvas id="chartCategory"></canvas></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ═══════════ ROW 3: Top Products + Status Bar + Payment Mix ═══════════ -->
      <div class="chart-grid-2-1">
        <div class="analytics-card">
          <div class="analytics-card-header">
            <div class="analytics-card-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-trophy" style="color:#f59e0b;"></i> Top Products by Revenue</div>
            <a href="products.html" class="btn-pill" style="font-size:11.5px;padding:3px 8px;">View All</a>
          </div>
          <div class="leaderboard-list" id="leaderboard">
            <div style="text-align:center;padding:30px;color:#94a3b8;"><i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading...</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="analytics-card">
          <div class="analytics-card-header">
            <div class="analytics-card-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-chart-bar" style="color:#0284c7;"></i> Orders by Status & Payment</div>
          </div>
          <div class="chart-canvas-wrap"><canvas id="chartStatus"></canvas></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ═══════════ ROW 4: Top Customers + Coupon Usage ═══════════ -->
      <div class="chart-grid-1-1">
        <div class="analytics-card">
          <div class="analytics-card-header">
            <div class="analytics-card-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-crown" style="color:#f59e0b;"></i> Top Customers by Spend</div>
            <a href="customers.html" class="btn-pill" style="font-size:11.5px;padding:3px 8px;">View All</a>
          </div>
          <div class="leaderboard-list" id="customerLeaderboard">
            <div style="text-align:center;padding:20px;color:#94a3b8;"><i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading...</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="analytics-card">
          <div class="analytics-card-header">
            <div class="analytics-card-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-ticket" style="color:#0f7139;"></i> Most Used Discount Coupons</div>
            <a href="discounts.html" class="btn-pill" style="font-size:11.5px;padding:3px 8px;">Manage</a>
          </div>
          <div class="chart-canvas-wrap"><canvas id="chartCoupons"></canvas></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ═══════════ ROW 5: Full Orders Ledger Table ═══════════ -->
      <div class="analytics-card" style="margin-bottom:40px;">
        <div class="analytics-card-header">
          <div class="analytics-card-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-receipt" style="color:#0f7139;"></i> Financial Orders Ledger <span id="ledgerCount" style="font-size:13px;font-weight:400;color:#64748b;margin-left:8px;"></span></div>
          <a href="orders.html" class="btn-pill" style="font-size:12px;padding:4px 10px;">Manage Orders</a>
        </div>
        <div class="table-scroll-container">
          <table class="shopify-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Order ID</th>
                <th>Date & Time</th>
                <th>Customer</th>
                <th>Items</th>
                <th>Coupon Used</th>
                <th>Discount (₹)</th>
                <th>Payment Mode</th>
                <th>Amount (₹)</th>
                <th>Status</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="ledgerBody">
              <tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center;padding:25px;color:#64748b;"><i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading financial transactions...</td></tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>

  <script src="../assets/js/admin-bulk.js"></script>
  <script>
    const API_BASE = 'http://localhost:5000/api';
    let analyticsData = null; // Full real data from backend
    let currentTF = 'all';

    // Chart instances
    let chartTimeline = null;
    let chartCategory = null;
    let chartStatus = null;
    let chartCoupons = null;

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 1.  LOAD from the dedicated real analytics API
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    async function loadAnalytics() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/analytics/summary`);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
        analyticsData = await res.json();

        document.getElementById('lastUpdated').textContent =
          'Updated: ' + new Date(analyticsData.generatedAt).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN');

        renderKPIs();
        renderTimeline();
        renderCategory();
        renderStatusChart();
        renderLeaderboard();
        renderCustomerLeaderboard();
        renderCouponChart();
        renderLedger();

        // Sidebar badge
        document.getElementById('sidebarOrdersBadge').textContent =
          analyticsData.kpis.totalOrders;

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[Analytics] Failed to load:', err);
        document.getElementById('ledgerBody').innerHTML =
          `<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center;padding:30px;color:#ef4444;">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> Failed to connect to analytics API. Make sure the server is running.
          </td></tr>`;
      }
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 2.  KPI CARDS
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function fmt(n) {
      return '₹' + Number(n).toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
    }
    function fmtInt(n) {
      return Number(n).toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
    }

    function renderKPIs() {
      const { kpis, products, customers, coupons, collections } = analyticsData;

      document.getElementById('kRevenue').textContent   = fmt(kpis.totalRevenue);
      document.getElementById('kOrders').textContent    = kpis.totalOrders;
      document.getElementById('kDelivered').textContent = kpis.deliveredOrders + ' orders';
      document.getElementById('kDeliveryRate').textContent = kpis.deliveryRate + '%';
      const elAOV = document.getElementById('kAOV'); if (elAOV) elAOV.textContent = fmt(kpis.aov);
      const elUnits = document.getElementById('kUnits'); if (elUnits) elUnits.textContent = kpis.totalUnitsSold;
      document.getElementById('kDiscount').textContent  = fmt(kpis.totalDiscount);
      document.getElementById('kCoupons').textContent   = coupons.active;
      document.getElementById('kInventory').textContent = '₹' + fmtInt(products.inventoryValue);
      document.getElementById('kProducts').textContent  = products.total;
      document.getElementById('kCollections').textContent = collections.total;
      document.getElementById('kCustomers').textContent = customers.customers;

      const topC = customers.topCustomers && customers.topCustomers[0];
      document.getElementById('kTopCustomer').textContent = topC
        ? topC.name + ' · ₹' + fmtInt(topC.spent)
        : 'No orders yet';
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 3.  TIMELINE CHART  (Revenue & Orders per day)
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function setTF(tf, btn) {
      currentTF = tf;
      document.querySelectorAll('.tf-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      renderTimeline();
    }

    function renderTimeline() {
      if (!analyticsData) return;
      const now     = Date.now();
      const days    = currentTF === '7d' ? 7 : currentTF === '30d' ? 30 : Infinity;
      const cutoff  = days === Infinity ? 0 : now - days * 86400000;

      const filtered = analyticsData.charts.timeline.filter(d =>
        new Date(d.date).getTime() >= cutoff
      );

      const labels  = filtered.map(d => {
        const dt = new Date(d.date);
        return dt.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
      });
      const revenue = filtered.map(d => Math.round(d.revenue * 100) / 100);
      const orders  = filtered.map(d => d.orders);

      if (chartTimeline) chartTimeline.destroy();
      chartTimeline = new Chart(document.getElementById('chartTimeline'), {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
          labels,
          datasets: [
            {
              label: 'Revenue Earned (₹)',
              data: revenue,
              borderColor: '#0f7139',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(15,113,57,.10)',
              fill: true,
              tension: .35,
              yAxisID: 'yR',
              borderWidth: 2.5,
              pointBackgroundColor: '#0f7139',
              pointRadius: 4,
              pointHoverRadius: 7
            },
            {
              label: 'Orders Count',
              data: orders,
              borderColor: '#0284c7',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(2,132,199,.06)',
              borderDash: [5, 4],
              tension: .3,
              yAxisID: 'yO',
              borderWidth: 2,
              pointBackgroundColor: '#0284c7',
              pointRadius: 3
            }
          ]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
          plugins: {
            legend: { position: 'top', labels: { boxWidth: 12, font: { weight: '600', size: 12 } } },
            tooltip: {
              callbacks: {
                label: ctx => ctx.dataset.yAxisID === 'yR'
                  ? ` Revenue: ₹${Number(ctx.raw).toLocaleString('en-IN')}`
                  : ` Orders: ${ctx.raw}`
              }
            }
          },
          scales: {
            x: { grid: { display: false } },
            yR: { type: 'linear', position: 'left',  grid: { color: '#f1f5f9' }, ticks: { callback: v => '₹' + v } },
            yO: { type: 'linear', position: 'right', grid: { display: false },  ticks: { stepSize: 1 } }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 4.  CATEGORY DOUGHNUT
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function renderCategory() {
      const cats = analyticsData.charts.categoryRevenue;
      document.getElementById('catCount').textContent =
        cats.length + ' Active ' + (cats.length === 1 ? 'Category' : 'Categories');

      if (chartCategory) chartCategory.destroy();

      const palette = ['#0f7139','#0284c7','#7c3aed','#f59e0b','#ec4899','#14b8a6','#ef4444','#64748b'];

      if (cats.length === 0) {
        // Show a placeholder for no data
        chartCategory = new Chart(document.getElementById('chartCategory'), {
          type: 'doughnut',
          data: {
            labels: ['No sales data yet'],
            datasets: [{ data: [1], backgroundColor: ['#e2e8f0'], borderWidth: 0 }]
          },
          options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false } } }
        });
        return;
      }

      chartCategory = new Chart(document.getElementById('chartCategory'), {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {
          labels: cats.map(c => c.name),
          datasets: [{
            data: cats.map(c => c.revenue),
            backgroundColor: palette.slice(0, cats.length),
            borderWidth: 2,
            borderColor: '#fff'
          }]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: {
            legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { boxWidth: 10, font: { size: 11.5, weight: '500' } } },
            tooltip: {
              callbacks: {
                label: ctx => ` ${ctx.label}: ₹${Number(ctx.raw).toLocaleString('en-IN')}`
              }
            }
          },
          cutout: '65%'
        }
      });
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 5.  ORDER STATUS + PAYMENT BAR CHART
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function renderStatusChart() {
      const sc = analyticsData.charts.statusCounts;
      const pc = analyticsData.charts.paymentCounts;

      const allLabels = [
        ...Object.keys(sc).map(k => 'Status: ' + k),
        ...Object.keys(pc).map(k => 'Pay: ' + k.substring(0, 12))
      ];
      const allData = [...Object.values(sc), ...Object.values(pc)];
      const colors = [
        '#10b981','#3b82f6','#8b5cf6','#ef4444','#f59e0b','#0f7139',
        '#0284c7','#7c3aed','#d97706','#ec4899'
      ];

      if (chartStatus) chartStatus.destroy();
      chartStatus = new Chart(document.getElementById('chartStatus'), {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
          labels: allLabels,
          datasets: [{
            label: 'Count',
            data: allData,
            backgroundColor: colors.slice(0, allLabels.length),
            borderRadius: 6
          }]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
          scales: {
            x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { font: { size: 10 } } },
            y: { grid: { color: '#f1f5f9' }, ticks: { stepSize: 1 } }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 6.  PRODUCT LEADERBOARD
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function renderLeaderboard() {
      const container = document.getElementById('leaderboard');
      const top = analyticsData.topProducts.slice(0, 5);

      if (top.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:20px;color:#94a3b8;">No products with sales yet.</div>';
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = top.map((p, i) => {
        const rankClass = i === 0 ? 'rank-gold' : i === 1 ? 'rank-silver' : i === 2 ? 'rank-bronze' : '';
        const imgSrc = p.image || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1596040033229-a9821ebd058d?w=80';
        return `
          <div class="leader-item">
            <div class="leader-left">
              <div class="leader-rank ${rankClass}">#${i+1}</div>
              <img src="${imgSrc}" class="leader-thumb" alt="${p.name}" onerror="this.src='https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1596040033229-a9821ebd058d?w=80';">
              <div class="leader-info">
                <span class="leader-name">${p.name}</span>
                <span class="leader-meta">${p.category} · ${p.stock} in stock · ₹${p.price}/unit</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="leader-right">
              <div class="leader-revenue">₹${Number(p.revenue).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
              <div class="leader-units">${p.units} units sold</div>
            </div>
          </div>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 7.  CUSTOMER LEADERBOARD
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function renderCustomerLeaderboard() {
      const container = document.getElementById('customerLeaderboard');
      const top = (analyticsData.customers.topCustomers || []).slice(0, 5);

      if (top.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:20px;color:#94a3b8;">No customer data yet.</div>';
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = top.map((c, i) => {
        const rankClass = i === 0 ? 'rank-gold' : i === 1 ? 'rank-silver' : i === 2 ? 'rank-bronze' : '';
        return `
          <div class="leader-item">
            <div class="leader-left">
              <div class="leader-rank ${rankClass}">#${i+1}</div>
              <div style="width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:#e8f5e9;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#0f7139;">
                ${(c.name || 'C').charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
              </div>
              <div class="leader-info">
                <span class="leader-name">${c.name || 'Customer'}</span>
                <span class="leader-meta">${c.email || ''} · ${c.orders} order${c.orders !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="leader-right">
              <div class="leader-revenue">₹${Number(c.spent).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
              <div class="leader-units">total spent</div>
            </div>
          </div>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 8.  COUPON USAGE BAR CHART
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function renderCouponChart() {
      const top = analyticsData.coupons.topCoupons || [];
      if (chartCoupons) chartCoupons.destroy();

      if (top.length === 0) {
        chartCoupons = new Chart(document.getElementById('chartCoupons'), {
          type: 'bar',
          data: { labels: ['No coupons used yet'], datasets: [{ data: [0], backgroundColor: '#e2e8f0', borderRadius: 6 }] },
          options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false } } }
        });
        return;
      }

      chartCoupons = new Chart(document.getElementById('chartCoupons'), {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
          labels: top.map(c => c.code),
          datasets: [{
            label: 'Times Used',
            data: top.map(c => c.count),
            backgroundColor: ['#0f7139','#0284c7','#7c3aed','#f59e0b','#ec4899'].slice(0, top.length),
            borderRadius: 6
          }]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: { legend: { display: false },
            tooltip: { callbacks: { label: ctx => ` Used ${ctx.raw} time${ctx.raw !== 1 ? 's' : ''}` } }
          },
          scales: {
            x: { grid: { display: false } },
            y: { grid: { color: '#f1f5f9' }, ticks: { stepSize: 1 }, title: { display: true, text: 'Times Applied', font: { size: 11 } } }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 9.  LEDGER TABLE (full order list)
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function statusClass(s) {
      if (!s) return 'sp-default';
      const sl = s.toLowerCase();
      if (sl === 'delivered') return 'sp-delivered';
      if (sl === 'cancelled') return 'sp-cancelled';
      if (['placed','confirmed','dispatched','processing','shipped'].includes(sl)) return 'sp-placed';
      return 'sp-default';
    }

    function renderLedger() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('ledgerBody');
      const orders = analyticsData.recentOrders;

      document.getElementById('ledgerCount').textContent =
        `(Showing ${orders.length} of ${analyticsData.kpis.totalOrders})`;

      if (!orders || orders.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center;padding:25px;color:#94a3b8;">No orders recorded yet.</td></tr>`;
        return;
      }

      tbody.innerHTML = orders.map(o => {
        const idShort = String(o._id).substring(0, 8);
        const dateStr = o.createdAt
          ? new Date(o.createdAt).toLocaleString('en-IN', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
          : 'Recent';
        const itemsCount = Array.isArray(o.orderItems)
          ? o.orderItems.reduce((s, item) => s + Number(item.qty || 1), 0)
          : 1;
        const couponTag = o.couponCode
          ? `<span style="font-family:monospace;background:#e8f5e9;color:#0f7139;border:1px dashed #0f7139;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;">${o.couponCode}</span>`
          : `<span style="color:#94a3b8;font-size:11.5px;">—</span>`;
        const discountStr = o.discountPrice > 0
          ? `<strong style="color:#ef4444;">-₹${Number(o.discountPrice).toFixed(2)}</strong>`
          : `<span style="color:#94a3b8;">—</span>`;

        return `
          <tr style="cursor:pointer;" onclick="window.location.href='orders.html'">
            <td><strong>#${idShort}</strong></td>
            <td style="color:#64748b;font-size:12px;">${dateStr}</td>
            <td><strong>${o.customerName || 'Customer'}</strong><br><span style="font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8;">${o.customerEmail || ''}</span></td>
            <td><span style="background:#f1f5f9;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:600;font-size:11.5px;">${itemsCount} item${itemsCount > 1 ? 's' : ''}</span></td>
            <td>${couponTag}</td>
            <td>${discountStr}</td>
            <td style="font-size:12px;color:#475569;">${o.paymentMethod || 'Razorpay Secure'}</td>
            <td><strong style="color:#0f7139;font-size:13.5px;">₹${Number(o.totalPrice).toFixed(2)}</strong></td>
            <td><span class="status-pill ${statusClass(o.status)}">${o.status || 'Placed'}</span></td>
          </tr>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 10. EXPORT CSV (uses real backend data)
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function exportCSV() {
      if (!analyticsData || !analyticsData.recentOrders) {
        alert('Data not loaded yet. Please wait or refresh.');
        return;
      }
      const headers = ['Order ID', 'Date', 'Customer', 'Email', 'Items Qty', 'Coupon', 'Discount (₹)', 'Payment Mode', 'Total (₹)', 'Status'];
      const rows = analyticsData.recentOrders.map(o => [
        o._id,
        o.createdAt ? new Date(o.createdAt).toISOString() : '',
        o.customerName || '',
        o.customerEmail || '',
        Array.isArray(o.orderItems) ? o.orderItems.reduce((s, i) => s + Number(i.qty || 1), 0) : 1,
        o.couponCode || '',
        o.discountPrice || 0,
        o.paymentMethod || '',
        o.totalPrice || 0,
        o.status || '',
      ]);
      AdminExport.downloadCSV('financial_report_' + new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0], headers, rows);
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadAnalytics);
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

  <script>
    const API_BASE = 'http://localhost:5000/api';

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async () => {
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const colId = urlParams.get('id');

      if (!colId) {
        document.getElementById('collectionHeading').textContent = "Collection Not Found";
        document.getElementById('collectionGridContainer').innerHTML = "<p>No ID provided in URL.</p>";
        return;
      }

      try {
        const colRes = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/collections/${colId}`);
        if (!colRes.ok) {
          document.getElementById('collectionHeading').textContent = "Collection Not Found";
          return;
        }

        const col = await colRes.json();

        function getCollectionImage(col) {
          if (col.image && col.image.trim() !== '') return col.image;
          const title = (col.title || col.name || '').toLowerCase();
          if (title.includes('oil')) return '../assets/images/banners/oils_banner_hero_golden.png';
          if (title.includes('dry fruit') || title.includes('nut') || title.includes('badam') || title.includes('kaju')) return 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1608797178974-15b35a64ede9?w=300&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80';
          if (title.includes('seed')) return '../assets/images/banners/seeds_banner_blue_bowls.png';
          if (title.includes('ghee') || title.includes('honey')) return '../assets/images/banners/ghee_honey_banner_jars.png';
          if (title.includes('cooking') || title.includes('essential')) return '../assets/images/banners/cooking_essentials_banner_pouches.png';
          if (title.includes('powder') || title.includes('podi')) return '../assets/images/banners/spice_powders_banner_pouches.png';
          if (title.includes('spice')) return '../assets/images/banners/spices_banner_pouches.png';
          return 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1596040033229-a9821ebd058d?w=300&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80';
        }

        document.getElementById('collectionHeading').textContent = col.title;
        document.getElementById('colBannerDesc').textContent = col.description || "Fresh natural products collection.";
        document.getElementById('colBannerImg').src = getCollectionImage(col);
        document.getElementById('ruleTagDisplay').textContent = (col.subcategories && col.subcategories.length > 0) ? col.subcategories.join(', ') : "Category matches collection";
        
        document.getElementById('colSeoTitle').textContent = `${col.title} | Arshith Fresh`;
        document.getElementById('colSeoUrl').textContent = `https://arshithfresh.com > collections > ${col.slug || col.title.toLowerCase()}`;
        document.getElementById('colSeoSnippet').textContent = (col.description || "").substring(0, 160) || `Buy authentic ${col.title} online from Arshith Fresh.`;

        // Fetch products to find which ones belong to this collection
        const prodRes = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/products`);
        const allProducts = await prodRes.json();
        
        const colProducts = allProducts.filter(p => p.category && p.category.toLowerCase() === col.title.toLowerCase());
        
        document.getElementById('colItemCountBadge').textContent = colProducts.length;

        // Render 4-Column Product Cards Grid
        const grid = document.getElementById('collectionGridContainer');
        if (colProducts.length === 0) {
          grid.innerHTML = "<p style='padding:20px; color:var(--text-secondary);'>No products found in this category.</p>";
        } else {
          grid.innerHTML = colProducts.map(p => {
            const stock = Number(p.countInStock) || 0;
            let statusClass = 'status-pill active';
            let statusText = `Active (${stock})`;
            if (stock === 0) {
              statusClass = 'status-pill out-of-stock';
              statusText = 'Out of stock (0)';
            } else if (stock < 10) {
              statusClass = 'status-pill low-stock';
              statusText = `Low Stock (${stock})`;
            }
            const imgUrl = p.image || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1596040033229-a9821ebd058d?w=300&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60';
            const title = p.name || 'Product';
            
            return `
            <a href="product-detail.html?id=${p._id}" class="col-product-card" title="Click to edit ${title}">
              <div class="col-product-img-wrapper" style="position:relative;">
                <img src="${imgUrl}" alt="${title}" onerror="this.src='https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1596040033229-a9821ebd058d?w=300';">
                <span class="${statusClass}" style="position:absolute; top:8px; left:8px; font-size:11px; padding:2px 8px;">${statusText}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="col-product-info">
                ${title}
                <div style="font-size:11.5px; color:#64748b; margin-top:2px;">₹${p.price || 0} / ${p.unit || '1 kg'} • <strong>${stock} left</strong></div>
              </div>
            </a>
            `;
          }).join('');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Error fetching collection:", err);
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

      <a href="../index.html" target="_blank" class="btn-view-as" style="text-decoration:none; color:inherit;">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8z"></path><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"></circle></svg>
        <span>View Store</span>

      <div class="store-profile-dropdown">
        <div class="store-avatar">AF</div>
        <span class="store-name-text">Arshith Fresh</span>

    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- App Layout -->
  <div class="app-container">
    <aside class="app-sidebar">
      <div class="sidebar-menu">
        <a href="dashboard.html" class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-left"><i class="fa-solid fa-house"></i><span>Dashboard</span></div></a>
        <a href="orders.html" class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-left"><i class="fa-solid fa-bag-shopping"></i><span>Orders</span></div></a>
        <a href="products.html" class="menu-item active"><div class="menu-item-left"><i class="fa-solid fa-tag"></i><span>Products</span></div></a>
        <div class="submenu-list">
          <a href="collections.html" class="submenu-item active">Collections / Categories</a>
          <a href="inventory.html" class="submenu-item">Inventory</a>
        </div>
        <a href="customers.html" class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-left"><i class="fa-solid fa-users"></i><span>Customers</span></div></a>
        <a href="discounts.html" class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-left"><i class="fa-solid fa-percent"></i><span>Discounts</span></div></a>
        <a href="reviews.html" class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-left"><i class="fa-solid fa-star"></i><span>Reviews</span></div></a>
      </div>

    <main class="main-viewport">
      <div class="page-top-header">
        <div class="page-title-row">
          <h1>Collections & Categories <span id="collectionCount" style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: normal; color: #6d7175;">(0)</span></h1>
        </div>
        <div class="page-action-buttons">
          <button class="btn-pill" onclick="fetchCollections()"><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i> Refresh</button>
          <button class="btn-pill btn-pill-primary" onclick="openAddModal()"><i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i> Add category</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="data-card">
        <div class="card-filter-bar">
          <span class="tab-all-pill" style="font-weight: 600;">All Categories</span>
          <div class="table-search-input-box" style="max-width: 400px;">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line></svg>
            <input type="text" id="collectionSearchInput" placeholder="Search by title or subcategory...">
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Sticky / Floating Bulk Actions Toolbar -->
        <div id="bulkActionsBar" class="bulk-actions-bar">
          <div class="bulk-selection-info">
            <span class="bulk-selection-badge"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> <span id="bulkSelectedCount">0</span> selected</span>
          </div>
          <div class="bulk-action-buttons">
            <button type="button" class="btn-bulk-action" onclick="exportSelectedCollections()"><i class="fa-solid fa-file-csv"></i> Export CSV</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn-bulk-action btn-bulk-danger" onclick="bulkDeleteCollections()"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i> Delete Selected</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn-bulk-close" onclick="deselectAll()" title="Deselect All"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i></button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="table-scroll-container">
          <table class="shopify-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style="width: 36px;"><input type="checkbox" class="custom-checkbox" id="selectAllCheckbox" title="Select All"></th>
                <th style="width: 220px;">Category</th>
                <th style="min-width: 280px;">Sub-categories</th>
                <th style="width: 150px; white-space: nowrap;">Products Count</th>
                <th style="width: 120px; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap;">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="collectionsTableBody">
              <tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align: center; padding: 25px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading...</td></tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>

  <!-- Add / Edit Collection Modal -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" id="collectionModal">
    <div class="modal-box" style="max-width: 600px; width: 95%;">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h3 id="collectionModalTitle">Add / Edit Category</h3>
        <button class="btn-icon" type="button" onclick="closeModal()" style="border:none; background:none; cursor:pointer; font-size:20px;">&times;</button>
      </div>
      <form id="collectionForm">
        <input type="hidden" id="collId">
        <div class="modal-body" style="padding: 20px 24px;">
          <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label" style="font-weight:600;">Category Title *</label>
            <input type="text" id="collTitle" class="form-control" placeholder="e.g. Oils, Spices, Dry Fruits" required style="width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:6px; font-size:13.5px;">
          </div>
          
          <div class="form-group" style="margin-top: 14px;">
            <label class="form-label" style="font-weight:600;">Sub-categories (comma-separated)</label>
            <input type="text" id="collSubcategories" class="form-control" placeholder="e.g. Cold-Pressed Groundnut Oil, Wood-Pressed Sesame Oil, Coconut Oil" style="width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:6px; font-size:13.5px;">
            <div style="font-size: 11.5px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 4px;">Separate multiple subcategories with commas.</div>
          </div>

          <div class="form-group" style="margin-top: 14px;">
            <label class="form-label" style="font-weight:600;">Category Image / Banner</label>
            
            <!-- Drag & Drop Upload Zone -->
            <div id="collImageDropzone" style="border: 2px dashed #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; padding: 18px 16px; text-align: center; background: #f8fafc; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease;">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-cloud-arrow-up" style="font-size: 24px; color: #0f7139; margin-bottom: 6px;"></i>
              <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #334155;">Click to upload local photo or drag & drop</div>
              <div style="font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 2px;">PNG, JPG, WEBP or GIF (Max 10MB)</div>
              <input type="file" id="collImageFile" accept="image/*" style="display: none;" onchange="handleCollFileSelect(event)">
            </div>

            <div style="margin-top: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
              <span style="font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; font-weight: 500;">Or URL:</span>
              <input type="text" id="collImage" class="form-control" placeholder="https://... or image URL" oninput="updateCollPreview(this.value)" style="flex:1; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:6px; font-size:12.5px;">
            </div>

            <!-- Preview Box -->
            <div id="collPreviewBox" style="margin-top: 10px; text-align: center; display: none;">
              <img id="collPreviewImg" src="" alt="Preview" style="max-height: 110px; max-width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; object-fit: cover;">
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="form-group" style="margin-top: 14px;">
            <label class="form-label" style="font-weight:600;">Description (Optional)</label>
            <textarea id="collDescription" class="form-control" rows="3" placeholder="Category story, health benefits or description..." style="width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:6px; font-size:13.5px; resize:vertical;"></textarea>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-footer" style="padding: 14px 24px; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px;">
          <button type="button" class="btn-pill" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>
          <button type="submit" class="btn-pill btn-pill-primary" id="saveCollBtn">Save Category</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script src="../assets/js/admin-bulk.js"></script>
  <script>
    const API_BASE = 'http://localhost:5000/api';
    const tbody = document.getElementById('collectionsTableBody');
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('collectionSearchInput');
    const modal = document.getElementById('collectionModal');
    const selectAllCheckbox = document.getElementById('selectAllCheckbox');
    const bulkBar = document.getElementById('bulkActionsBar');
    const bulkCountSpan = document.getElementById('bulkSelectedCount');

    let allCollections = [];
    let allProducts = [];
    let displayedCollections = [];

    async function fetchCollections() {
      try {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align: center; padding: 25px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading...</td></tr>';
        
        const [res, prodRes] = await Promise.all([
          fetch(`${API_BASE}/collections`),
          fetch(`${API_BASE}/products`)
        ]);

        if (res.ok) {
          allCollections = await res.json();
        }
        if (prodRes.ok) {
          allProducts = await prodRes.json();
        }

        renderTable(allCollections);
        updateSelectionState();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching categories:', err);
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align: center; padding: 20px; color: #ef4444;">Failed to load categories.</td></tr>';
      }
    }

    function getCollectionImage(col) {
      if (col && col.image && col.image.trim() !== '') return col.image;
      const title = (col ? (col.title || col.name || '') : '').toLowerCase();
      if (title.includes('oil')) return '../assets/images/banners/oils_banner_hero_golden.png';
      if (title.includes('dry fruit') || title.includes('nut') || title.includes('badam') || title.includes('kaju')) return 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1608797178974-15b35a64ede9?w=300&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80';
      if (title.includes('seed')) return '../assets/images/banners/seeds_banner_blue_bowls.png';
      if (title.includes('ghee') || title.includes('honey')) return '../assets/images/banners/ghee_honey_banner_jars.png';
      if (title.includes('cooking') || title.includes('essential')) return '../assets/images/banners/cooking_essentials_banner_pouches.png';
      if (title.includes('vegetable') || title.includes('veggie')) return 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1540420773420-3366772f4999?w=300&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80';
      if (title.includes('dairy') || title.includes('milk') || title.includes('paneer') || title.includes('curd')) return 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1550583724-b2692b85b150?w=300&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80';
      if (title.includes('powder') || title.includes('podi')) return '../assets/images/banners/spice_powders_banner_pouches.png';
      if (title.includes('spice')) return '../assets/images/banners/spices_banner_pouches.png';
      return 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1596040033229-a9821ebd058d?w=300&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80';
    }

    function renderTable(collections) {
      tbody.innerHTML = '';
      const list = Array.isArray(collections) ? collections : [];
      displayedCollections = list;
      
      const countElem = document.getElementById('collectionCount');
      if (countElem) {
        countElem.textContent = `(${list.length})`;
      }

      if (list.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align: center; padding: 25px; color: #6d7175;">No categories found. Click "+ Add category" to create one.</td></tr>';
        updateSelectionState();
        return;
      }

      list.forEach(col => {
        if (!col) return;
        const colTitle = col.title || col.name || 'Untitled Category';
        const prodCount = (Array.isArray(allProducts) ? allProducts : []).filter(p => p && p.category && p.category.toLowerCase() === colTitle.toLowerCase()).length;
        const subs = Array.isArray(col.subcategories) ? col.subcategories : [];
        const subTags = subs.length > 0
          ? subs.map(s => `<span class="subcat-tag">${s}</span>`).join('')
          : '<span style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px; font-style:italic;">No sub-categories</span>';

        const imgUrl = getCollectionImage(col);

        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.dataset.id = col._id;
        tr.dataset.title = colTitle;
        tr.dataset.slug = col.slug || '';
        tr.dataset.subs = subs.join(', ');
        tr.dataset.count = prodCount;

        tr.innerHTML = `
          <td><input type="checkbox" class="custom-checkbox row-checkbox" value="${col._id}"></td>
          <td>
            <div class="table-product-item">
              <img src="${imgUrl}" class="table-product-thumb" alt="${colTitle}" onerror="this.src='https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1596040033229-a9821ebd058d?w=80';">
              <div>
                <span class="table-product-name" style="font-weight: 600; color:#1a1a1a;">${colTitle}</span>
                <div style="font-size:11.5px; color:#6d7175;">${col.slug || ''}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </td>
          <td style="max-width: 380px;">
            <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 0;">
              ${subTags}
            </div>
          </td>
          <td style="white-space: nowrap;"><strong>${prodCount}</strong> products</td>
          <td style="text-align: right; white-space: nowrap;">
            <div style="display:flex; gap:6px; justify-content:flex-end;">
              <button class="action-btn-sm" title="Edit Category & Subcategories" onclick="openEditModal('${col._id}')"><i class="fa-solid fa-pen"></i> Edit</button>
              <button class="action-btn-sm action-btn-danger" title="Delete" onclick="deleteCollection('${col._id}', '${colTitle.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i></button>
            </div>
          </td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });

      attachRowCheckboxListeners();
    }

    // Selection Tracking
    function attachRowCheckboxListeners() {
      const rowCheckboxes = tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox');
      rowCheckboxes.forEach(cb => {
        cb.addEventListener('change', () => {
          const row = cb.closest('tr');
          if (cb.checked) {
            row.classList.add('row-selected');
          } else {
            row.classList.remove('row-selected');
          }
          updateSelectionState();
        });
      });
    }

    function getSelectedRows() {
      const selected = [];
      tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox:checked').forEach(cb => {
        const row = cb.closest('tr');
        selected.push({
          id: cb.value,
          title: row.dataset.title,
          slug: row.dataset.slug,
          subs: row.dataset.subs,
          count: row.dataset.count
        });
      });
      return selected;
    }

    function updateSelectionState() {
      const selected = getSelectedRows();
      const count = selected.length;
      const allCheckboxes = tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox');

      if (count > 0) {
        bulkCountSpan.textContent = count;
        bulkBar.classList.add('active');
      } else {
        bulkBar.classList.remove('active');
      }

      if (selectAllCheckbox) {
        if (allCheckboxes.length > 0 && count === allCheckboxes.length) {
          selectAllCheckbox.checked = true;
          selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = false;
        } else if (count > 0) {
          selectAllCheckbox.checked = false;
          selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = true;
        } else {
          selectAllCheckbox.checked = false;
          selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = false;
        }
      }
    }

    if (selectAllCheckbox) {
      selectAllCheckbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
        const isChecked = this.checked;
        const allCheckboxes = tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox');
        allCheckboxes.forEach(cb => {
          cb.checked = isChecked;
          const row = cb.closest('tr');
          if (isChecked) row.classList.add('row-selected');
          else row.classList.remove('row-selected');
        });
        updateSelectionState();
      });
    }

    function deselectAll() {
      if (selectAllCheckbox) {
        selectAllCheckbox.checked = false;
        selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = false;
      }
      tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox').forEach(cb => {
        cb.checked = false;
        cb.closest('tr').classList.remove('row-selected');
      });
      updateSelectionState();
    }

    // Bulk Action: Export Collections CSV
    function exportSelectedCollections() {
      const selected = getSelectedRows();
      if (selected.length === 0) return;

      const headers = ['Category ID', 'Category Title', 'Slug', 'Subcategories', 'Products Count'];
      const rows = selected.map(c => [c.id, c.title, c.slug, c.subs || 'None', c.count]);
      AdminExport.downloadCSV('categories_export', headers, rows);
    }

    // Bulk Action: Delete Selected Collections
    async function bulkDeleteCollections() {
      const selected = getSelectedRows();
      if (selected.length === 0) return;

      if (!confirm(`⚠️ Permanently delete ${selected.length} selected category(ies)? Products under these categories will remain available.`)) return;

      const ids = selected.map(c => c.id);
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/collections/bulk-delete`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-admin-dev': 'true' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ ids })
        });

        if (res.ok) {
          AdminToast.show(`Successfully deleted ${ids.length} category(ies)!`, 'success');
          deselectAll();
          fetchCollections();
        } else {
          AdminToast.show('Failed to delete categories', 'error');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        AdminToast.show('Error deleting categories', 'error');
      }
    }

    if (searchInput) {
      searchInput.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
        const q = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim();
        if (!q) {
          renderTable(allCollections);
          return;
        }
        const filtered = allCollections.filter(c => {
          const title = (c.title || '').toLowerCase();
          const subs = (c.subcategories || []).join(' ').toLowerCase();
          return title.includes(q) || subs.includes(q);
        });
        renderTable(filtered);
      });
    }

    function handleCollFileSelect(event) {
      const file = event.target.files && event.target.files[0];
      if (!file) return;

      if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
        AdminToast.show('Please select an image file (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF)', 'error');
        return;
      }

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = function(e) {
        const base64 = e.target.result;
        document.getElementById('collImage').value = base64;
        updateCollPreview(base64);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }

    function updateCollPreview(url) {
      const box = document.getElementById('collPreviewBox');
      const img = document.getElementById('collPreviewImg');
      if (url && (url.trim().startsWith('http') || url.trim().startsWith('data:image'))) {
        img.src = url.trim();
        box.style.display = 'block';
      } else {
        box.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }

    const collDropzone = document.getElementById('collImageDropzone');
    if (collDropzone) {
      collDropzone.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.getElementById('collImageFile').click();
      });
    }

    function openAddModal() {
      document.getElementById('collectionForm').reset();
      document.getElementById('collId').value = '';
      document.getElementById('collectionModalTitle').textContent = 'Add New Category';
      updateCollPreview('');
      modal.classList.add('active');
    }

    function openEditModal(id) {
      const col = allCollections.find(c => String(c._id) === String(id));
      if (!col) return;

      document.getElementById('collId').value = col._id;
      document.getElementById('collTitle').value = col.title || '';
      document.getElementById('collSubcategories').value = Array.isArray(col.subcategories) ? col.subcategories.join(', ') : (col.subcategories || '');
      document.getElementById('collImage').value = col.image || '';
      document.getElementById('collDescription').value = col.description || '';

      updateCollPreview(col.image || '');
      document.getElementById('collectionModalTitle').textContent = 'Edit Category & Sub-categories';
      modal.classList.add('active');
    }

    function closeModal() {
      modal.classList.remove('active');
    }

    document.getElementById('collectionForm').addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();

      const id = document.getElementById('collId').value;
      const title = document.getElementById('collTitle').value.trim();
      const subcategoriesRaw = document.getElementById('collSubcategories').value;
      const image = document.getElementById('collImage').value.trim();
      const description = document.getElementById('collDescription').value.trim();

      const subcategories = subcategoriesRaw.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);

      const payload = {
        title,
        subcategories,
        image: image || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1596040033229-a9821ebd058d?w=80',
        description
      };

      const btn = document.getElementById('saveCollBtn');
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.textContent = 'Saving...';

      try {
        const url = id ? `${API_BASE}/collections/${id}` : `${API_BASE}/collections`;
        const method = id ? 'PUT' : 'POST';

        const res = await fetch(url, {
          method,
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-admin-dev': 'true' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });

        if (!res.ok) {
          const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
          throw new Error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
        }

        AdminToast.show(id ? 'Category updated successfully!' : 'Category created successfully!', 'success');
        closeModal();
        fetchCollections();
      } catch (err) {
        AdminToast.show('Error: ' + err.message, 'error');
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = 'Save Category';
      }
    });

    async function deleteCollection(id, title) {
      if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete category "${title}"?`)) return;

      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/collections/${id}`, {
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: { 'x-admin-dev': 'true' }
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          AdminToast.show('Category deleted successfully!', 'success');
          fetchCollections();
        } else {
          AdminToast.show('Failed to delete category.', 'error');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        AdminToast.show('Error deleting category.', 'error');
      }
    }

    function openImageLightbox(e, src, title) {
      if (e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation();
      const lightbox = document.getElementById('imgPreviewLightbox');
      const img = document.getElementById('imgPreviewLightboxImg');
      const caption = document.getElementById('imgPreviewLightboxTitle');
      if (!lightbox || !img) return;

      img.src = src;
      caption.textContent = title || 'Category Image Preview';
      lightbox.classList.add('active');
    }

    function closeImageLightbox(e) {
      if (e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation();
      const lightbox = document.getElementById('imgPreviewLightbox');
      if (lightbox) lightbox.classList.remove('active');
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target && e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains('table-product-thumb')) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        openImageLightbox(e, e.target.src, e.target.alt || e.target.title || 'Category Image');
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') closeImageLightbox();
    });

    window.openImageLightbox = openImageLightbox;
    window.closeImageLightbox = closeImageLightbox;
    window.openEditModal = openEditModal;
    window.deleteCollection = deleteCollection;
    window.openAddModal = openAddModal;
    window.closeModal = closeModal;

    fetchCollections();
  </script>

  <!-- Universal Image Preview Lightbox Modal -->
  <div id="imgPreviewLightbox" class="img-preview-lightbox" onclick="closeImageLightbox(event)">
    <div class="img-preview-card" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
      <button type="button" class="img-preview-close-btn" onclick="closeImageLightbox(event)">&times;</button>
      <img id="imgPreviewLightboxImg" src="" alt="Full Preview">
      <div id="imgPreviewLightboxTitle" class="img-preview-title">Category Image</div>
    </div>
  </div>

</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<!DOCTYPE html>
