```html
        <span>admin</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="topbar-center">
      <div class="search-box-wrapper">
        <svg class="search-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line></svg>
        <input type="text" class="global-search-input" placeholder="Search customers...">
        <span class="kbd-shortcut">CTRL K</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="topbar-right">
      <a href="../index.html" target="_blank" class="btn-view-as" style="text-decoration:none; color:inherit;">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8z"></path><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"></circle></svg>
        <span>View Store</span>
      </a>
      <div class="store-profile-dropdown">
        <div class="store-avatar">AF</div>
        <span class="store-name-text">Arshith Fresh</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- App Layout -->
  <div class="app-container">
    <aside class="app-sidebar">
      <div class="sidebar-menu">
        <a href="dashboard.html" class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-left"><i class="fa-solid fa-house"></i><span>Dashboard</span></div></a>
        <a href="orders.html" class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-left"><i class="fa-solid fa-bag-shopping"></i><span>Orders</span></div></a>
        <a href="products.html" class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-left"><i class="fa-solid fa-tag"></i><span>Products</span></div></a>
        <div class="submenu-list">
          <a href="collections.html" class="submenu-item">Collections / Categories</a>
          <a href="inventory.html" class="submenu-item">Inventory</a>
        </div>
        <a href="customers.html" class="menu-item active"><div class="menu-item-left"><i class="fa-solid fa-users"></i><span>Customers</span></div></a>
        <a href="discounts.html" class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-left"><i class="fa-solid fa-percent"></i><span>Discounts</span></div></a>
        <a href="reviews.html" class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-left"><i class="fa-solid fa-star"></i><span>Reviews</span></div></a>
      </div>
    </aside>

    <main class="main-viewport">
      <div class="page-top-header">
        <div class="page-title-row">
          <h1>Customers & Users <span id="customerCount" style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: normal; color: #6d7175;">(0)</span></h1>
        </div>
        <div class="page-action-buttons">
          <button class="btn-pill" onclick="fetchCustomers()"><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i> Refresh</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="data-card">
        <div class="card-filter-bar">
          <span class="tab-all-pill" style="font-weight: 600;">All Registered Users</span>
          <div class="table-search-input-box" style="max-width: 400px;">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line></svg>
            <input type="text" id="customerSearchInput" placeholder="Search by name, email, or phone...">
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Sticky / Floating Bulk Actions Toolbar -->
        <div id="bulkActionsBar" class="bulk-actions-bar">
          <div class="bulk-selection-info">
            <span class="bulk-selection-badge"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> <span id="bulkSelectedCount">0</span> selected</span>
          </div>
          <div class="bulk-action-buttons">
            <button type="button" class="btn-bulk-action" onclick="copySelectedEmails()"><i class="fa-solid fa-envelope"></i> Copy Emails</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn-bulk-action" onclick="exportSelectedUsers()"><i class="fa-solid fa-file-csv"></i> Export CSV</button>
            
            <div class="bulk-dropdown">
              <button type="button" class="btn-bulk-action bulk-dropdown-toggle"><i class="fa-solid fa-user-gear"></i> Change Role <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-down" style="font-size: 10px; margin-left: 2px;"></i></button>
              <div class="bulk-dropdown-menu">
                <button type="button" class="bulk-dropdown-item" onclick="bulkSetRole('customer')"><i class="fa-solid fa-user"></i> Set as Customer</button>
                <button type="button" class="bulk-dropdown-item" onclick="bulkSetRole('admin')"><i class="fa-solid fa-shield"></i> Set as Admin</button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button type="button" class="btn-bulk-action btn-bulk-danger" onclick="bulkDeleteUsers()"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i> Delete Selected</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn-bulk-close" onclick="deselectAll()" title="Deselect All"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i></button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="table-scroll-container">
          <table class="shopify-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style="width: 36px;"><input type="checkbox" class="custom-checkbox" id="selectAllCheckbox" title="Select All"></th>
                <th>Customer / User</th>
                <th>Email</th>
                <th>Phone</th>
                <th>Role</th>
                <th>City / Location</th>
                <th>Joined Date</th>
                <th style="text-align: right;">Action</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="customersTableBody">
              <tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align: center; padding: 25px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading users...</td></tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>

  <script src="../assets/js/admin-bulk.js"></script>
  <script>
    const API_BASE = 'http://localhost:5000/api';
    const tbody = document.getElementById('customersTableBody');
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('customerSearchInput');
    const selectAllCheckbox = document.getElementById('selectAllCheckbox');
    const bulkBar = document.getElementById('bulkActionsBar');
    const bulkCountSpan = document.getElementById('bulkSelectedCount');

    let allUsers = [];
    let displayedUsers = [];

    async function fetchCustomers() {
      try {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align: center; padding: 25px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading users...</td></tr>';
        
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/users`);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error();
        allUsers = await res.json();

        document.getElementById('customerCount').textContent = `(${allUsers.length})`;
        displayedUsers = allUsers;
        renderUsers(allUsers);
        updateSelectionState();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching customers:', err);
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align: center; padding: 20px; color: #ef4444;">Failed to load users from database.</td></tr>';
      }
    }

    function renderUsers(users) {
      displayedUsers = users || [];
      tbody.innerHTML = '';
      if (!users || users.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align: center; padding: 25px; color: #6d7175;">No registered users found.</td></tr>';
        updateSelectionState();
        return;
      }

      users.forEach(u => {
        const name = u.name || 'User';
        const date = new Date(u.createdAt || Date.now()).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
        const isAdm = u.role === 'admin';

        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.dataset.id = u._id;
        tr.dataset.name = name;
        tr.dataset.email = u.email || '';
        tr.dataset.phone = u.phone || '';
        tr.dataset.role = u.role || 'customer';
        tr.dataset.location = u.city || u.street || 'India';
        tr.dataset.date = date;

        tr.innerHTML = `
          <td><input type="checkbox" class="custom-checkbox row-checkbox" value="${u._id}"></td>
          <td>
            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
              <div style="width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; background:#e2e8f0; color:#334155; font-weight:700; font-size:13px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">
                ${name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
              </div>
              <div>
                <strong style="color: #1a1a1a;">${name}</strong>
              </div>
            </div>
          </td>
          <td><a href="mailto:${u.email}" style="color:#0f7139; font-weight:500;">${u.email}</a></td>
          <td>${u.phone || '<span style="color:#94a3b8;">-</span>'}</td>
          <td>
            <span class="status-pill ${isAdm ? 'active' : 'draft'}">${isAdm ? 'Admin' : 'Customer'}</span>
          </td>
          <td>${u.city || u.street || 'India'}</td>
          <td><span style="font-size: 12px; color: #64748b;">${date}</span></td>
          <td style="text-align: right;">
            <button class="action-btn-sm action-btn-danger" title="Delete User" onclick="deleteSingleUser('${u._id}', '${name.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i>
            </button>
          </td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });

      attachRowCheckboxListeners();
    }

    // Selection Tracking
    function attachRowCheckboxListeners() {
      const rowCheckboxes = tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox');
      rowCheckboxes.forEach(cb => {
        cb.addEventListener('change', () => {
          const row = cb.closest('tr');
          if (cb.checked) {
            row.classList.add('row-selected');
          } else {
            row.classList.remove('row-selected');
          }
          updateSelectionState();
        });
      });
    }

    function getSelectedRows() {
      const selected = [];
      tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox:checked').forEach(cb => {
        const row = cb.closest('tr');
        selected.push({
          id: cb.value,
          name: row.dataset.name,
          email: row.dataset.email,
          phone: row.dataset.phone,
          role: row.dataset.role,
          location: row.dataset.location,
          date: row.dataset.date
        });
      });
      return selected;
    }

    function updateSelectionState() {
      const selected = getSelectedRows();
      const count = selected.length;
      const allCheckboxes = tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox');

      if (count > 0) {
        bulkCountSpan.textContent = count;
        bulkBar.classList.add('active');
      } else {
        bulkBar.classList.remove('active');
      }

      if (selectAllCheckbox) {
        if (allCheckboxes.length > 0 && count === allCheckboxes.length) {
          selectAllCheckbox.checked = true;
          selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = false;
        } else if (count > 0) {
          selectAllCheckbox.checked = false;
          selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = true;
        } else {
          selectAllCheckbox.checked = false;
          selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = false;
        }
      }
    }

    if (selectAllCheckbox) {
      selectAllCheckbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
        const isChecked = this.checked;
        const allCheckboxes = tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox');
        allCheckboxes.forEach(cb => {
          cb.checked = isChecked;
          const row = cb.closest('tr');
          if (isChecked) row.classList.add('row-selected');
          else row.classList.remove('row-selected');
        });
        updateSelectionState();
      });
    }

    function deselectAll() {
      if (selectAllCheckbox) {
        selectAllCheckbox.checked = false;
        selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = false;
      }
      tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox').forEach(cb => {
        cb.checked = false;
        cb.closest('tr').classList.remove('row-selected');
      });
      updateSelectionState();
    }

    // Bulk Action: Copy Emails
    function copySelectedEmails() {
      const selected = getSelectedRows();
      if (selected.length === 0) return;

      const emails = selected.map(u => u.email).filter(Boolean);
      if (emails.length === 0) {
        AdminToast.show('No emails available for selected users', 'error');
        return;
      }

      const emailStr = emails.join(', ');
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(emailStr).then(() => {
        AdminToast.show(`Copied ${emails.length} email(s) to clipboard!`, 'success');
      }).catch(() => {
        AdminToast.show(`Emails: ${emailStr}`, 'info');
      });
    }

    // Bulk Action: Export to CSV
    function exportSelectedUsers() {
      const selected = getSelectedRows();
      if (selected.length === 0) return;

      const headers = ['User ID', 'Name', 'Email', 'Phone', 'Role', 'City / Location', 'Joined Date'];
      const rows = selected.map(u => [u.id, u.name, u.email, u.phone || '-', u.role, u.location, u.date]);
      AdminExport.downloadCSV('customers_export', headers, rows);
    }

    // Bulk Action: Update Role
    async function bulkSetRole(newRole) {
      const selected = getSelectedRows();
      if (selected.length === 0) return;

      const ids = selected.map(u => u.id);
      if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to set role "${newRole}" for ${ids.length} selected user(s)?`)) {
        return;
      }

      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/users/bulk-role`, {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-admin-dev': 'true' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ ids, role: newRole })
        });

        if (res.ok) {
          AdminToast.show(`Successfully updated role to "${newRole}" for ${ids.length} user(s)!`, 'success');
          deselectAll();
          fetchCustomers();
        } else {
          const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
          AdminToast.show('Failed to update roles: ' + (err.message || 'Error'), 'error');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        AdminToast.show('Network error updating roles', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Bulk Action: Delete Selected Users
    async function bulkDeleteUsers() {
      const selected = getSelectedRows();
      if (selected.length === 0) return;

      const ids = selected.map(u => u.id);
      if (!confirm(`⚠️ Are you sure you want to permanently delete ${ids.length} selected customer account(s)? This action cannot be undone.`)) {
        return;
      }

      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/users/bulk-delete`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-admin-dev': 'true' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ ids })
        });

        if (res.ok) {
          AdminToast.show(`Successfully deleted ${ids.length} user(s)!`, 'success');
          deselectAll();
          fetchCustomers();
        } else {
          const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
          AdminToast.show('Failed to delete users: ' + (err.message || 'Error'), 'error');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        AdminToast.show('Network error deleting users', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Delete single user
    async function deleteSingleUser(id, name) {
      if (!confirm(`Delete customer account for "${name}"?`)) return;

      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/users/${id}`, {
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: { 'x-admin-dev': 'true' }
        });

        if (res.ok) {
          AdminToast.show(`User "${name}" deleted!`, 'success');
          fetchCustomers();
        } else {
          AdminToast.show('Failed to delete user', 'error');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        AdminToast.show('Network error deleting user', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Search filter
    if (searchInput) {
      searchInput.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
        const q = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim();
        if (!q) {
          renderUsers(allUsers);
          return;
        }
        const filtered = allUsers.filter(u => {
          const name = (u.name || '').toLowerCase();
          const email = (u.email || '').toLowerCase();
          const phone = (u.phone || '').toLowerCase();
          return name.includes(q) || email.includes(q) || phone.includes(q);
        });
        renderUsers(filtered);
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fetchCustomers);
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

```html
          <div class="analytics-card-header">
            <div class="analytics-card-title">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-credit-card" style="color: #0284c7;"></i> Payment & Status Mix
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="chart-canvas-container">
            <canvas id="paymentStatusChart"></canvas>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

      <!-- 4. Recent Financial Orders Stream -->
      <div class="analytics-card" style="margin-bottom: 40px;">
        <div class="analytics-card-header">
          <div class="analytics-card-title">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-receipt" style="color: #0f7139;"></i> Latest Financial Orders
          </div>
          <a href="orders.html" class="btn-pill" style="font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 10px;">Manage All Orders</a>
        </div>

        <div class="table-scroll-container">
          <table class="shopify-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Order ID</th>
                <th>Date & Time</th>
                <th>Customer</th>
                <th>Items Ordered</th>
                <th>Payment Mode</th>
                <th>Amount Earned (₹)</th>
                <th>Status</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="financialOrdersTableBody">
              <tr>
                <td colspan="7" style="text-align: center; padding: 25px; color: #64748b;">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading financial transactions...
                </td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

    </main>
  </div>

  <!-- JAVASCRIPT ANALYTICS ENGINE -->
  <script src="../assets/js/admin-bulk.js"></script>
  <script>
    const API_BASE = 'http://localhost:5000/api';

    let rawOrders = [];
    let rawProducts = [];
    let rawCollections = [];

    let timelineChartInstance = null;
    let categoryChartInstance = null;
    let paymentChartInstance = null;

    let currentTimeframe = 'all';

    async function loadFinancialDashboard() {
      try {
        const [ordRes, prodRes, colRes] = await Promise.all([
          fetch(`${API_BASE}/orders`, { headers: { 'x-admin-dev': 'true' } }),
          fetch(`${API_BASE}/products`),
          fetch(`${API_BASE}/collections`)
        ]);

        rawOrders = await ordRes.json().catch(() => []);
        rawProducts = await prodRes.json().catch(() => []);
        rawCollections = await colRes.json().catch(() => []);

        document.getElementById('sidebarOrdersBadge').textContent = rawOrders.length;

        // Calculate and render all metrics
        computeKPIs();
        renderTimelineChart();
        renderCategoryDoughnut();
        renderPaymentStatusChart();
        renderTopProductsLeaderboard();
        renderRecentFinancialOrders();

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error loading financial analytics:', err);
      }
    }

    // 1. Financial KPIs Calculation
    function computeKPIs() {
      // Delivered / Active Revenue vs Total
      let totalMoneyEarned = 0;
      let totalUnitsSold = 0;
      let deliveredCount = 0;

      rawOrders.forEach(o => {
        const total = Number(o.totalPrice || 0);
        if (o.status !== 'Cancelled') {
          totalMoneyEarned += total;
        }
        if (o.status === 'Delivered') {
          deliveredCount++;
        }
        if (Array.isArray(o.orderItems)) {
          o.orderItems.forEach(item => {
            totalUnitsSold += Number(item.qty || item.quantity || 1);
          });
        }
      });

      const orderCount = rawOrders.length;
      const activeOrders = rawOrders.filter(o => o.status !== 'Cancelled').length;
      const aov = activeOrders > 0 ? (totalMoneyEarned / activeOrders) : 0;
      const deliveredPercent = orderCount > 0 ? Math.round((deliveredCount / orderCount) * 100) : 0;

      // Inventory Total Value
      let totalCatalogInventoryValue = 0;
      rawProducts.forEach(p => {
        const price = Number(p.price || 0);
        const stock = Number(p.countInStock || 0);
        totalCatalogInventoryValue += (price * stock);
      });

      // Format currency
      document.getElementById('kpiTotalRevenue').textContent = `₹${totalMoneyEarned.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
      document.getElementById('kpiTotalOrders').textContent = orderCount;
      document.getElementById('kpiDeliveredRate').textContent = `${deliveredPercent}% fulfilled`;
      const aovEl = document.getElementById('kpiAOV'); if (aovEl) aovEl.textContent = `₹${aov.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
      const unitsEl = document.getElementById('kpiUnitsSold'); if (unitsEl) unitsEl.textContent = `${totalUnitsSold} items sold`;
      document.getElementById('kpiInventoryValue').textContent = `₹${totalCatalogInventoryValue.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 0 })}`;
      document.getElementById('kpiProductCount').textContent = `${rawProducts.length} Products`;
    }

    // 2. Timeline Chart (Revenue & Orders over Time)
    function setTimeframe(tf, btn) {
      currentTimeframe = tf;
      document.querySelectorAll('.chart-filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
      renderTimelineChart();
    }

    function renderTimelineChart() {
      const ctx = document.getElementById('revenueTimelineChart');
      if (!ctx) return;

      // Group orders by date
      const dateMap = {}; // 'YYYY-MM-DD' -> { revenue: 0, orders: 0 }

      const now = new Date();
      let cutoffDays = 365;
      if (currentTimeframe === '7d') cutoffDays = 7;
      if (currentTimeframe === '30d') cutoffDays = 30;

      const cutoffDate = new Date(now.getTime() - (cutoffDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));

      rawOrders.forEach(o => {
        const d = new Date(o.createdAt || Date.now());
        if (d < cutoffDate) return;

        const key = d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        if (!dateMap[key]) {
          dateMap[key] = { revenue: 0, orders: 0, label: d.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }) };
        }
        if (o.status !== 'Cancelled') {
          dateMap[key].revenue += Number(o.totalPrice || 0);
        }
        dateMap[key].orders += 1;
      });

      // Sort dates
      const sortedKeys = Object.keys(dateMap).sort();
      let labels = sortedKeys.map(k => dateMap[k].label);
      let revenueData = sortedKeys.map(k => Math.round(dateMap[k].revenue));
      let ordersData = sortedKeys.map(k => dateMap[k].orders);

      if (sortedKeys.length === 0) {
        labels = ['No Data'];
        revenueData = [0];
        ordersData = [0];
      }

      if (timelineChartInstance) {
        timelineChartInstance.destroy();
      }

      timelineChartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
          labels,
          datasets: [
            {
              label: 'Revenue Earned (₹)',
              data: revenueData,
              borderColor: '#0f7139',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 113, 57, 0.12)',
              fill: true,
              tension: 0.35,
              yAxisID: 'yRevenue',
              borderWidth: 2.5,
              pointBackgroundColor: '#0f7139',
              pointRadius: 4,
              pointHoverRadius: 6
            },
            {
              label: 'Orders Count',
              data: ordersData,
              borderColor: '#0284c7',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.08)',
              borderDash: [4, 4],
              tension: 0.3,
              yAxisID: 'yOrders',
              borderWidth: 2,
              pointBackgroundColor: '#0284c7',
              pointRadius: 3
            }
          ]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
          plugins: {
            legend: {
              position: 'top',
              labels: { boxWidth: 12, font: { weight: '600', size: 12 } }
            },
            tooltip: {
              callbacks: {
                label: function(context) {
                  if (context.dataset.yAxisID === 'yRevenue') {
                    return ` Revenue: ₹${context.raw.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`;
                  }
                  return ` Orders: ${context.raw}`;
                }
              }
            }
          },
          scales: {
            x: { grid: { display: false } },
            yRevenue: {
              type: 'linear',
              position: 'left',
              grid: { color: '#f1f5f9' },
              ticks: {
                callback: value => `₹${value}`
              }
            },
            yOrders: {
              type: 'linear',
              position: 'right',
              grid: { display: false },
              ticks: { stepSize: 1 }
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // 3. Category Revenue Doughnut Chart
    function renderCategoryDoughnut() {
      const ctx = document.getElementById('categoryRevenueChart');
      if (!ctx) return;

      const categoryRevenueMap = {};

      rawOrders.forEach(o => {
        if (o.status === 'Cancelled') return;
        if (Array.isArray(o.orderItems)) {
          o.orderItems.forEach(item => {
            const itemPrice = Number(item.price || 0) * Number(item.qty || item.quantity || 1);
            // Match with product to get category
            let matchedCat = 'Oils';
            const prod = rawProducts.find(p => String(p._id) === String(item.product) || p.name === item.name);
            if (prod && prod.category) {
              matchedCat = prod.category;
            } else if (item.name) {
              if (item.name.toLowerCase().includes('oil')) matchedCat = 'Oils';
              else if (item.name.toLowerCase().includes('seed')) matchedCat = 'Seeds';
              else if (item.name.toLowerCase().includes('powder') || item.name.toLowerCase().includes('podi')) matchedCat = 'Spice Powders';
              else if (item.name.toLowerCase().includes('ghee') || item.name.toLowerCase().includes('honey')) matchedCat = 'Ghee & Honey';
            }
            categoryRevenueMap[matchedCat] = (categoryRevenueMap[matchedCat] || 0) + itemPrice;
          });
        }
      });

      const categories = Object.keys(categoryRevenueMap);
      const revenues = categories.map(c => Math.round(categoryRevenueMap[c]));

      document.getElementById('categoryCountBadge').textContent = `${categories.length} Active Categories`;

      const palette = ['#0f7139', '#0284c7', '#7c3aed', '#f59e0b', '#ec4899', '#14b8a6', '#64748b'];

      if (categoryChartInstance) {
        categoryChartInstance.destroy();
      }

      categoryChartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {
          labels: categories.length > 0 ? categories : ['Oils', 'Ghee & Honey', 'Seeds', 'Spice Powders'],
          datasets: [{
            data: revenues.length > 0 ? revenues : [5000, 2000, 1500, 1000],
            backgroundColor: palette.slice(0, categories.length || 4),
            borderWidth: 2,
            borderColor: '#ffffff'
          }]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: {
            legend: {
              position: 'bottom',
              labels: { boxWidth: 10, font: { size: 11.5, weight: '500' } }
            },
            tooltip: {
              callbacks: {
                label: function(context) {
                  const label = context.label || '';
                  const val = context.raw || 0;
                  return ` ${label}: ₹${val.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`;
                }
              }
            }
          },
          cutout: '65%'
        }
      });
    }

    // 4. Payment & Order Status Mix
    function renderPaymentStatusChart() {
      const ctx = document.getElementById('paymentStatusChart');
      if (!ctx) return;

      let delivered = 0, confirmed = 0, placed = 0, cancelled = 0;
      let razorpayCount = 0, codCount = 0;

      rawOrders.forEach(o => {
        if (o.status === 'Delivered') delivered++;
        else if (o.status === 'Confirmed' || o.status === 'Dispatched') confirmed++;
        else if (o.status === 'Cancelled') cancelled++;
        else placed++;

        const mode = (o.paymentMethod || '').toLowerCase();
        if (mode.includes('cod') || mode.includes('cash')) codCount++;
        else razorpayCount++;
      });

      if (paymentChartInstance) {
        paymentChartInstance.destroy();
      }

      paymentChartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
          labels: ['Delivered', 'In Transit / Confirmed', 'Placed', 'Cancelled', 'Razorpay', 'Cash on Delivery'],
          datasets: [{
            label: 'Count',
            data: [delivered, confirmed, placed, cancelled, razorpayCount, codCount],
            backgroundColor: [
              '#10b981',
              '#3b82f6',
              '#8b5cf6',
              '#ef4444',
              '#0f7139',
              '#f59e0b'
            ],
            borderRadius: 6
          }]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: {
            legend: { display: false }
          },
          scales: {
            x: { grid: { display: false } },
            y: { grid: { color: '#f1f5f9' }, ticks: { stepSize: 1 } }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // 5. Top Selling Products Leaderboard
    function renderTopProductsLeaderboard() {
      const container = document.getElementById('topProductsList');
      if (!container) return;

      const productPerformance = {}; // prodName -> { name, units, revenue, category, img, stock }

      // Seed all products
      rawProducts.forEach(p => {
        const name = p.name || p.title || 'Product';
        productPerformance[name] = {
          name,
          category: p.category || 'General',
          units: 0,
          revenue: 0,
          img: (p.images && p.images[0] && p.images[0].url) || p.image || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1596040033229-a9821ebd058d?w=80',
          stock: Number(p.countInStock || 0)
        };
      });

      // Tally order sales
      rawOrders.forEach(o => {
        if (o.status === 'Cancelled') return;
        if (Array.isArray(o.orderItems)) {
          o.orderItems.forEach(item => {
            const name = item.name;
            const qty = Number(item.qty || item.quantity || 1);
            const price = Number(item.price || 0);

            if (name && productPerformance[name]) {
              productPerformance[name].units += qty;
              productPerformance[name].revenue += (qty * price);
            } else if (name) {
              productPerformance[name] = {
                name,
                category: 'General',
                units: qty,
                revenue: (qty * price),
                img: item.image || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1596040033229-a9821ebd058d?w=80',
                stock: 10
              };
            }
          });
        }
      });

      const sortedProducts = Object.values(productPerformance).sort((a, b) => b.revenue - a.revenue).slice(0, 5);

      if (sortedProducts.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center; padding:20px; color:#94a3b8;">No products found.</div>`;
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = sortedProducts.map((p, idx) => {
        let rankClass = '';
        if (idx === 0) rankClass = 'gold';
        else if (idx === 1) rankClass = 'silver';
        else if (idx === 2) rankClass = 'bronze';

        return `
          <div class="top-product-item">
            <div class="top-product-left">
              <div class="top-product-rank ${rankClass}">#${idx + 1}</div>
              <img src="${p.img}" class="top-product-thumb" alt="${p.name}" onerror="this.src='https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1596040033229-a9821ebd058d?w=80';">
              <div class="top-product-info">
                <span class="top-product-name">${p.name}</span>
                <span class="top-product-meta">${p.category} &bull; ${p.stock} in stock</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="top-product-right">
              <div class="top-product-revenue">₹${p.revenue.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
              <div class="top-product-units">${p.units} units sold</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    // 6. Recent Financial Orders Stream Table
    function renderRecentFinancialOrders() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('financialOrdersTableBody');
      if (!tbody) return;

      if (!rawOrders || rawOrders.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center; padding:25px; color:#94a3b8;">No orders recorded yet.</td></tr>`;
        return;
      }

      const recentOrders = rawOrders.slice(0, 8);

      tbody.innerHTML = recentOrders.map(o => {
        const idShort = String(o._id || '').substring(0, 8);
        const dateStr = o.createdAt ? new Date(o.createdAt).toLocaleString('en-IN', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) : 'Recent';
        const customer = o.customerName || (o.shippingAddress ? o.shippingAddress.address : 'Customer');
        const itemsCount = Array.isArray(o.orderItems) ? o.orderItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.qty || 1), 0) : 1;
        const total = Number(o.totalPrice || 0);

        let statusClass = 'draft';
        if (o.status === 'Delivered') statusClass = 'active';
        else if (o.status === 'Cancelled') statusClass = 'cancelled';

        return `
          <tr style="cursor:pointer;" onclick="window.location.href='orders.html'">
            <td><strong>#${idShort}</strong></td>
            <td style="color:#64748b; font-size:12px;">${dateStr}</td>
            <td><strong>${customer}</strong></td>
            <td><span style="background:#f1f5f9; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600; font-size:11.5px;">${itemsCount} item${itemsCount > 1 ? 's' : ''}</span></td>
            <td><span style="font-size:12px; color:#475569;"><i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved" style="color:#0f7139; margin-right:4px;"></i>${o.paymentMethod || 'Razorpay'}</span></td>
            <td><strong style="color:#0f7139; font-size:13.5px;">₹${total.toFixed(2)}</strong></td>
            <td><span class="status-pill ${statusClass}">${o.status || 'Placed'}</span></td>
          </tr>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    // 7. CSV Export for Financial Report
    function exportFinancialCSV() {
      if (!rawOrders || rawOrders.length === 0) {
        alert('No orders available to export.');
        return;
      }

      const headers = ['Order ID', 'Date Placed', 'Customer Name', 'Items Count', 'Payment Mode', 'Revenue Earned (₹)', 'Fulfillment Status'];
      const rows = rawOrders.map(o => [
        o._id,
        o.createdAt ? new Date(o.createdAt).toISOString() : '',
        o.customerName || '',
        Array.isArray(o.orderItems) ? o.orderItems.length : 1,
        o.paymentMethod || 'Razorpay',
        o.totalPrice || 0,
        o.status || 'Placed'
      ]);

      AdminExport.downloadCSV('financial_sales_report', headers, rows);
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadFinancialDashboard);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
    @keyframes modalSlide {

      to { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }

      font-size: 20px;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: #64748b;
    }
    .modal-body {
      padding: 20px;
    }
    .form-group {
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .form-label {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #334155;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .form-control {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 14px;
      outline: none;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    .form-control:focus {
      border-color: #0f7139;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15, 113, 57, 0.12);
    }
    .modal-footer {
      padding: 14px 20px;
      border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 10px;
      background: #f8fafc;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- =========================================================================
       1. GLOBAL TOP HEADER
       ========================================================================= -->
  <header class="global-topbar">
    <div class="topbar-left">
      <div class="shopify-logo">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 109.5 124.5">
          <path d="M74.7 14.1c-.2 0-.4.1-.5.1-.2-.8-.6-1.5-1.1-2.2-2.1-2.9-5.7-4.4-10.7-4.4-1.2 0-2.5.1-3.7.4-4.8 1.1-9.4 3.9-13.6 8.3-3 3.1-6.1 7.6-7.8 11.2-.8 1.7-1.5 3.3-2.1 4.7l-15.6 4.8c-4.8 1.5-5 1.9-5.6 6.9L.1 113.1c-.5 4.3 2.5 8 6.8 8.4.4 0 .9 0 1.3-.1l74-15.3c4.5-.9 7.7-4.9 7.4-9.5l-14.9-82.5z"/>
        </svg>
        <span>admin</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Center Global Search with CTRL K -->
    <div class="topbar-center">
      <div class="search-box-wrapper">
        <svg class="search-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
          <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle>
          <line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line>
        </svg>
        <input type="text" id="adminGlobalSearch" class="global-search-input" placeholder="Search coupons, products, orders...">
        <span class="kbd-shortcut">CTRL K</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Right Header Actions -->
    <div class="topbar-right">
      <a href="../index.html" class="view-store-btn" target="_blank">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M18 13v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"></path><polyline points="15 3 21 3 21 9"></polyline><line x1="10" y1="14" x2="21" y2="3"></line></svg>
        <span>View Store</span>
      </a>

      <button class="notification-btn" aria-label="Notifications">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M18 8A6 6 0 0 0 6 8c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9"></path><path d="M13.73 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.46 0"></path></svg>
        <span class="notification-dot"></span>
      </button>

      <div class="store-profile-dropdown">
        <div class="store-avatar">AF</div>
        <span class="store-name-text">Arshith Fresh</span>
        <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline></svg>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- =========================================================================
       2. APP LAYOUT (SIDEBAR + MAIN CONTENT)
       ========================================================================= -->
  <div class="app-container">

    <!-- Left Sidebar Navigation -->
    <aside class="app-sidebar">
      <div class="sidebar-menu">
        
        <!-- Dashboard -->
        <a href="dashboard.html" class="menu-item">
          <div class="menu-item-left">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="m3 9 9-7 9 7v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z"></path></svg>
            <span>Dashboard</span>
          </div>
        </a>


        <!-- Orders -->
        <a href="orders.html" class="menu-item">
          <div class="menu-item-left">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="9" cy="21" r="1"></circle><circle cx="20" cy="21" r="1"></circle><path d="M1 1h4l2.68 13.39a2 2 0 0 0 2 1.61h9.72a2 2 0 0 0 2-1.61L23 6H6"></path></svg>
            <span>Orders</span>
          </div>
          <span class="badge-count" id="sidebarOrdersBadge">0</span>
        </a>

        <!-- Products -->
        <a href="products.html" class="menu-item">
          <div class="menu-item-left">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M16.5 9.4 7.55 4.24a1.78 1.78 0 0 0-2.5 1.55v12.42a1.78 1.78 0 0 0 2.5 1.55L16.5 14.6a1.78 1.78 0 0 0 0-3.2z"></path></svg>
            <span>Products</span>
          </div>
        </a>

        <!-- Submenu Links for Products -->
        <div class="submenu-list">
          <a href="collections.html" class="submenu-item">Collections / Categories</a>
          <a href="inventory.html" class="submenu-item">Inventory</a>
        </div>

        <!-- Customers -->
        <a href="customers.html" class="menu-item">
          <div class="menu-item-left">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"></path><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"></circle></svg>
            <span>Customers</span>
          </div>
        </a>

        <!-- Discounts / Coupons (Active) -->
        <a href="discounts.html" class="menu-item active">
          <div class="menu-item-left">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M20.59 13.41l-7.17 7.17a2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0L2 12V2h10l8.59 8.59a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.82z"></path><line x1="7" y1="7" x2="7.01" y2="7"></line></svg>
            <span>Discounts</span>
          </div>
        </a>

        <!-- Reviews -->
        <a href="reviews.html" class="menu-item">
          <div class="menu-item-left">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polygon points="12 2 15.09 8.26 22 9.27 17 14.14 18.18 21.02 12 17.77 5.82 21.02 7 14.14 2 9.27 8.91 8.26 12 2"></polygon></svg>
            <span>Reviews</span>
          </div>
          <span class="badge-count" id="sidebarCouponsBadge" style="background:#0f7139; color:#fff;">0</span>
        </a>

      </div>

      <!-- Server Status -->
      <div class="sidebar-bottom">
        <div style="padding: 10px 14px; background: #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: #334155;">
          <div style="width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #22c55e;"></div>
          <span>MongoDB Live (5000)</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </aside>

    <!-- =======================================================================
         3. MAIN VIEWPORT - DISCOUNTS & COUPONS MANAGEMENT
         ======================================================================= -->
    <main class="main-viewport">
      
      <!-- Top Action Bar -->
      <div class="page-top-header">
        <div class="page-title-row">
          <h1>Discounts & Coupons</h1>
          <p style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: #64748b;">Manage tiered discount promo codes applicable during cart & checkout.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="page-action-buttons">
          <button class="btn-pill" onclick="fetchCoupons()"><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i> Refresh</button>
          <button class="btn-pill btn-pill-primary" onclick="openAddCouponModal()"><i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i> Create Coupon</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- KPI Summary Cards -->
      <div class="kpi-grid">
        <div class="kpi-card">
          <div>
            <div class="kpi-title">Total Coupons</div>
            <div class="kpi-value" id="kpiTotalCoupons">0</div>
          </div>
          <div class="kpi-icon-box kpi-icon-green"><i class="fa-solid fa-tags"></i></div>
        </div>

        <div class="kpi-card">
          <div>
            <div class="kpi-title">Active Discounts</div>
            <div class="kpi-value" id="kpiActiveCoupons">0</div>
          </div>
          <div class="kpi-icon-box kpi-icon-blue"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i></div>
        </div>

        <div class="kpi-card">
          <div>
            <div class="kpi-title">Min Order Start</div>
            <div class="kpi-value" id="kpiMinOrder">₹1,000</div>
          </div>
          <div class="kpi-icon-box kpi-icon-amber"><i class="fa-solid fa-cart-shopping"></i></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Main Data Card with Table -->
      <div class="data-card">
        
        <!-- Search Bar -->
        <div class="card-filter-bar" style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf2f7;">
          <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; flex: 1;">
            <div class="table-search-input-box" style="max-width: 380px; min-width: 260px; margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; background: #fff;">
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line></svg>
              <input type="text" id="couponSearchInput" placeholder="Search coupons by code or description..." oninput="applyFilters()" style="border: none; outline: none; width: 100%; font-size: 13.5px; font-family: inherit;">
            </div>
          </div>

          <div id="couponsCountBadge" style="font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #64748b; white-space: nowrap;">
            Showing 0 coupons
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Sticky / Floating Bulk Actions Toolbar -->
        <div id="bulkActionsBar" class="bulk-actions-bar">
          <div class="bulk-selection-info">
            <span class="bulk-selection-badge"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> <span id="bulkSelectedCount">0</span> selected</span>
          </div>
          <div class="bulk-action-buttons">
            <button type="button" class="btn-bulk-action" onclick="bulkToggleCouponActive(true)"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i> Mark Active</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn-bulk-action" onclick="bulkToggleCouponActive(false)"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-xmark"></i> Mark Inactive</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn-bulk-action" onclick="exportCouponsCSV()"><i class="fa-solid fa-file-csv"></i> Export CSV</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn-bulk-action btn-bulk-danger" onclick="bulkDeleteCoupons()"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i> Delete Selected</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn-bulk-close" onclick="deselectAllCoupons()" title="Deselect All"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i></button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Scrollable Coupons Table -->
        <div class="table-scroll-container">
          <table class="shopify-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style="width: 40px;"><input type="checkbox" id="selectAllCheckbox"></th>
                <th>Coupon Code</th>
                <th>Discount Rate</th>
                <th>Min Order Requirement</th>
                <th>Offer Description</th>
                <th>Status</th>
                <th style="text-align: right;">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="couponsTableBody">
              <tr>
                <td colspan="7" style="text-align: center; padding: 30px; color: #64748b;">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading coupons...
                </td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

    </main>
  </div>

  <!-- =========================================================================
       4. CREATE / EDIT COUPON MODAL
       ========================================================================= -->
  <div id="couponModal" class="modal-overlay" onclick="closeCouponModal(event)">
    <div class="modal-card" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h3 id="modalTitle">Create New Discount Coupon</h3>
        <button type="button" class="modal-close-btn" onclick="closeCouponModal()">&times;</button>
      </div>
      
      <form id="couponForm" onsubmit="handleSaveCoupon(event)">
        <input type="hidden" id="couponEditId">
        <div class="modal-body">
          <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label" for="formCouponCode">Coupon Code *</label>
            <input type="text" id="formCouponCode" required placeholder="e.g. SAVE25, FESTIVE20" class="form-control" style="text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">
            <span style="font-size: 11.5px; color: #64748b;">Code that customers enter at checkout (letters & numbers only).</span>
          </div>

          <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px;">
            <div class="form-group">
              <label class="form-label" for="formDiscountPercent">Discount Percentage (%) *</label>
              <input type="number" id="formDiscountPercent" required min="1" max="100" placeholder="e.g. 20" class="form-control">
            </div>

            <div class="form-group">
              <label class="form-label" for="formMinOrder">Min Order Amount (₹) *</label>
              <input type="number" id="formMinOrder" required min="0" placeholder="e.g. 5000" class="form-control">
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label" for="formDescription">Offer Title / Description</label>
            <input type="text" id="formDescription" placeholder="e.g. 20% OFF on orders above ₹5,000" class="form-control">
          </div>

          <div class="form-group">
            <label style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; cursor: pointer;">
              <input type="checkbox" id="formIsActive" checked style="width: 18px; height: 18px; accent-color: #0f7139;">
              <span>Active (Available for customer checkout immediately)</span>
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="modal-footer">
          <button type="button" class="btn-pill" onclick="closeCouponModal()">Cancel</button>
          <button type="submit" class="btn-pill btn-pill-primary" id="saveCouponBtn">Save Coupon</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- JAVASCRIPT LOGIC -->
  <script src="../assets/js/admin-bulk.js"></script>
  <script>
    const API_BASE = window.location.origin.includes(':5000') ? 'http://localhost:5000/api' : (window.location.origin.startsWith('file:') || window.location.origin.includes('127.0.0.1') || window.location.origin.includes('localhost')) ? 'http://localhost:5000/api' : '/api';
    let allCoupons = [];
    const selectAllCheckbox = document.getElementById('selectAllCheckbox');
    const bulkBar = document.getElementById('bulkActionsBar');
    const bulkCountSpan = document.getElementById('bulkSelectedCount');

    async function fetchCoupons() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('couponsTableBody');
      try {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align: center; padding: 25px; color: #64748b;"><i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading coupons...</td></tr>`;
        
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/coupons/all`);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error();
        allCoupons = await res.json();
        
        updateKPIs();
        applyFilters();
        updateSelectionState();
      } catch (err) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align: center; padding: 25px; color: #ef4444;">Failed to load coupons from API. Server live on port 5000.</td></tr>`;
      }
    }

    function updateKPIs() {
      const total = allCoupons.length;
      const active = allCoupons.filter(c => c.isActive !== false).length;
      const minOrders = allCoupons.map(c => c.minOrderAmount || 0).filter(n => n > 0);
      const minOrderStart = minOrders.length > 0 ? Math.min(...minOrders) : 1000;

      document.getElementById('kpiTotalCoupons').textContent = total;
      document.getElementById('kpiActiveCoupons').textContent = active;
      document.getElementById('kpiMinOrder').textContent = `₹${minOrderStart.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`;
      
      const badge = document.getElementById('sidebarCouponsBadge');
      if (badge) badge.textContent = active;
    }

    function applyFilters() {
      const term = (document.getElementById('couponSearchInput').value || '').toLowerCase().trim();

      const filtered = allCoupons.filter(c => {
        return !term || (c.code || '').toLowerCase().includes(term) || (c.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(term);
      });

      document.getElementById('couponsCountBadge').textContent = `Showing ${filtered.length} of ${allCoupons.length} coupons`;
      renderCouponsTable(filtered);
      updateSelectionState();
    }

    function renderCouponsTable(coupons) {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('couponsTableBody');
      tbody.innerHTML = '';

      if (!coupons || coupons.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align: center; padding: 35px; color: #64748b;"><i class="fa-solid fa-tags" style="font-size:24px; margin-bottom:8px; display:block; opacity:0.6;"></i>No coupons found. Click "+ Create Coupon" to add one.</td></tr>`;
        updateSelectionState();
        return;
      }

      coupons.forEach(c => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        const isActive = c.isActive !== false;
        const statusPill = isActive 
          ? `<span class="status-pill active"><i class="fa-solid fa-check" style="font-size:10px; margin-right:4px;"></i>Active</span>`
          : `<span class="status-pill draft">Inactive</span>`;

        tr.dataset.id = c._id || c.code;
        tr.dataset.code = c.code;
        tr.dataset.discount = c.discountPercent;
        tr.dataset.minOrder = c.minOrderAmount || 0;
        tr.dataset.desc = c.description || '';
        tr.dataset.status = isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive';

        tr.innerHTML = `
          <td><input type="checkbox" class="custom-checkbox row-checkbox" value="${c._id || c.code}"></td>
          <td>
            <div class="coupon-code-pill">
              <span>${c.code}</span>
              <button type="button" class="copy-coupon-btn" onclick="copyCode('${c.code}')" title="Copy code">
                <i class="fa-regular fa-copy"></i>
              </button>
            </div>
          </td>
          <td><span class="discount-percent-tag">${c.discountPercent}% OFF</span></td>
          <td><strong>₹${(c.minOrderAmount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</strong></td>
          <td style="color: #334155; font-size: 13px;">${c.description || `${c.discountPercent}% OFF`}</td>
          <td>${statusPill}</td>
          <td style="text-align: right;">
            <button class="action-btn-sm" onclick="openEditCouponModal('${c._id || c.code}')" title="Edit Coupon">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-pen"></i> Edit
            </button>
            <button class="action-btn-sm action-btn-danger" onclick="deleteCoupon('${c._id}', '${c.code}')" title="Delete Coupon">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i>
            </button>
          </td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });

      attachRowCheckboxListeners();
    }

    function attachRowCheckboxListeners() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('couponsTableBody');
      const rowCheckboxes = tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox');
      rowCheckboxes.forEach(cb => {
        cb.addEventListener('change', () => {
          const row = cb.closest('tr');
          if (cb.checked) row.classList.add('row-selected');
          else row.classList.remove('row-selected');
          updateSelectionState();
        });
      });
    }

    function getSelectedRows() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('couponsTableBody');
      const selected = [];
      tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox:checked').forEach(cb => {
        const row = cb.closest('tr');
        selected.push({
          id: cb.value,
          code: row.dataset.code,
          discount: row.dataset.discount,
          minOrder: row.dataset.minOrder,
          desc: row.dataset.desc,
          status: row.dataset.status
        });
      });
      return selected;
    }

    function updateSelectionState() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('couponsTableBody');
      const selected = getSelectedRows();
      const count = selected.length;
      const allCheckboxes = tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox');

      if (count > 0) {
        bulkCountSpan.textContent = count;
        bulkBar.classList.add('active');
      } else {
        bulkBar.classList.remove('active');
      }

      if (selectAllCheckbox) {
        if (allCheckboxes.length > 0 && count === allCheckboxes.length) {
          selectAllCheckbox.checked = true;
          selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = false;
        } else if (count > 0) {
          selectAllCheckbox.checked = false;
          selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = true;
        } else {
          selectAllCheckbox.checked = false;
          selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = false;
        }
      }
    }

    if (selectAllCheckbox) {
      selectAllCheckbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
        const tbody = document.getElementById('couponsTableBody');
        const isChecked = this.checked;
        const allCheckboxes = tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox');
        allCheckboxes.forEach(cb => {
          cb.checked = isChecked;
          const row = cb.closest('tr');
          if (isChecked) row.classList.add('row-selected');
          else row.classList.remove('row-selected');
        });
        updateSelectionState();
      });
    }

    function deselectAllCoupons() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('couponsTableBody');
      if (selectAllCheckbox) {
        selectAllCheckbox.checked = false;
        selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = false;
      }
      tbody.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox').forEach(cb => {
        cb.checked = false;
        cb.closest('tr').classList.remove('row-selected');
      });
      updateSelectionState();
    }

    async function bulkToggleCouponActive(isActive) {
      const selected = getSelectedRows();
      if (selected.length === 0) return;

      const ids = selected.map(c => c.id);
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/coupons/bulk-status`, {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-admin-dev': 'true' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ ids, isActive })
        });

        if (res.ok) {
          AdminToast.show(`Updated status for ${ids.length} coupon(s)!`, 'success');
          deselectAllCoupons();
          fetchCoupons();
        } else {
          AdminToast.show('Failed to update coupons', 'error');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        AdminToast.show('Error updating coupons', 'error');
      }
    }

    function exportCouponsCSV() {
      const selected = getSelectedRows();
      if (selected.length === 0) return;

      const headers = ['Coupon Code', 'Discount Percent (%)', 'Min Order Requirement (₹)', 'Description', 'Status'];
      const rows = selected.map(c => [c.code, `${c.discount}%`, `₹${c.minOrder}`, c.desc, c.status]);
      AdminExport.downloadCSV('coupons_export', headers, rows);
    }

    async function bulkDeleteCoupons() {
      const selected = getSelectedRows();
      if (selected.length === 0) return;

      if (!confirm(`⚠️ Permanently delete ${selected.length} selected coupon(s)?`)) return;

      const ids = selected.map(c => c.id);
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/coupons/bulk-delete`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-admin-dev': 'true' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ ids })
        });

        if (res.ok) {
          AdminToast.show(`Successfully deleted ${ids.length} coupon(s)!`, 'success');
          deselectAllCoupons();
          fetchCoupons();
        } else {
          AdminToast.show('Failed to delete coupons', 'error');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        AdminToast.show('Error deleting coupons', 'error');
      }
    }

    function copyCode(code) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
      alert(`Copied "${code}" to clipboard!`);
    }

    // Modal Handlers
    function openAddCouponModal() {
      document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = 'Create New Discount Coupon';
      document.getElementById('couponEditId').value = '';
      document.getElementById('formCouponCode').value = '';
      document.getElementById('formCouponCode').disabled = false;
      document.getElementById('formDiscountPercent').value = '';
      document.getElementById('formMinOrder').value = '';
      document.getElementById('formDescription').value = '';
      document.getElementById('formIsActive').checked = true;
      document.getElementById('couponModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    function openEditCouponModal(idOrCode) {
      const coupon = allCoupons.find(c => c._id === idOrCode || c.code === idOrCode);
      if (!coupon) return;

      document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = `Edit Coupon "${coupon.code}"`;
      document.getElementById('couponEditId').value = coupon._id || '';
      document.getElementById('formCouponCode').value = coupon.code;
      document.getElementById('formDiscountPercent').value = coupon.discountPercent;
      document.getElementById('formMinOrder').value = coupon.minOrderAmount || 0;
      document.getElementById('formDescription').value = coupon.description || '';
      document.getElementById('formIsActive').checked = coupon.isActive !== false;
      document.getElementById('couponModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    function closeCouponModal(e) {
      if (e && e.target && e.target.id !== 'couponModal' && !e.target.classList.contains('modal-close-btn') && !e.target.classList.contains('btn-pill')) return;
      document.getElementById('couponModal').classList.remove('active');
    }

    async function handleSaveCoupon(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const saveBtn = document.getElementById('saveCouponBtn');
      saveBtn.disabled = true;
      saveBtn.textContent = 'Saving...';

      const id = document.getElementById('couponEditId').value;
      const code = document.getElementById('formCouponCode').value.trim().toUpperCase();
      const discountPercent = Number(document.getElementById('formDiscountPercent').value);
      const minOrderAmount = Number(document.getElementById('formMinOrder').value);
      const description = document.getElementById('formDescription').value.trim();
      const isActive = document.getElementById('formIsActive').checked;

      const payload = { code, discountPercent, minOrderAmount, description, isActive };

      try {
        const url = id ? `${API_BASE}/coupons/${id}` : `${API_BASE}/coupons`;
        const method = id ? 'PUT' : 'POST';

        const res = await fetch(url, {
          method,
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });

        const data = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Failed to save coupon');

        alert(id ? 'Coupon updated successfully!' : 'Coupon created successfully!');
        closeCouponModal();
        fetchCoupons();
      } catch (err) {
        alert('Error: ' + err.message);
      } finally {
        saveBtn.disabled = false;
        saveBtn.textContent = 'Save Coupon';
      }
    }

    async function deleteCoupon(id, code) {
      if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete coupon "${code}"?`)) return;

      try {
        if (!id || id.startsWith('mock_')) {
          alert('Cannot delete this item.');
          return;
        }
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/coupons/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Could not delete coupon');
        alert('Coupon deleted successfully!');
        fetchCoupons();
      } catch (err) {
        alert('Error deleting coupon: ' + err.message);
      }
    }

    // Orders Count for sidebar
    async function fetchOrdersCount() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/orders`);
        if (res.ok) {
          const orders = await res.json();
          const badge = document.getElementById('sidebarOrdersBadge');
          if (badge) badge.textContent = orders.length;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // Global Search & CTRL+K Event Listeners
    const topGlobalSearch = document.getElementById('adminGlobalSearch');
    if (topGlobalSearch) {
      topGlobalSearch.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        const query = e.target.value;
        const localSearch = document.getElementById('couponSearchInput');
        if (localSearch) {
          localSearch.value = query;
          applyFilters();
        }
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (topGlobalSearch) {
          topGlobalSearch.focus();
          topGlobalSearch.select();
        }
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      fetchCoupons();
      fetchOrdersCount();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
                <th>Price</th>
                <th>Available Quantity</th>
                <th>Status</th>
                <th style="text-align:right;">Save Quantity</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="inventoryTbody">
              <tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align: center; padding: 25px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading inventory from database...</td></tr>
```
