    <script src="../../assets/js/script.js"></script>
    <script>
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const redirectDestination = urlParams.get('redirect') || '../../index.html';

        async function handleRegisterForm(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const firstName = document.getElementById('regFirstName').value.trim();
            const lastName = document.getElementById('regLastName').value.trim();
            const email = document.getElementById('regEmail').value.trim();
            const phone = document.getElementById('regPhone').value.trim();
            const password = document.getElementById('regPassword').value;
            const submitBtn = document.getElementById('regSubmitBtn');
            const alertBox = document.getElementById('registerAlertBox');

            const fullName = (firstName + ' ' + lastName).trim();

            if (alertBox) alertBox.style.display = 'none';
            submitBtn.disabled = true;
            submitBtn.innerText = 'Creating account...';

            try {
                const res = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/users/register', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ name: fullName, email, password, phone })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Registration failed');

                localStorage.setItem('arshith_user', JSON.stringify(data));
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Account created! Welcome to Arshith Fresh.');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = redirectDestination;
                }, 600);
            } catch (err) {
                if (alertBox) {
                    alertBox.innerText = err.message;
                    alertBox.style.display = 'block';
                } else {
                    alert(err.message);
                }
                submitBtn.disabled = false;
                submitBtn.innerText = 'Create Account';
            }
        }

        // Google Identity Services Official Credential Handler
        function decodeJwtResponse(token) {
            var base64Url = token.split('.')[1];
            var base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
            var jsonPayload = decodeURIComponent(atob(base64).split('').map(function(c) {
                return '%' + ('00' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2);
            }).join(''));
            return JSON.parse(jsonPayload);
        }

        async function handleGoogleCredentialResponse(response) {
            try {
                const responsePayload = decodeJwtResponse(response.credential);
                console.log("Authenticated with Google:", responsePayload);

                const res = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/users/google-auth', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        email: responsePayload.email,
                        name: responsePayload.name,
                        picture: responsePayload.picture,
                        googleId: responsePayload.sub
                    })
                });

                const data = await res.json();
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Google registration failed');

                localStorage.setItem('arshith_user', JSON.stringify(data));
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Welcome to Arshith Fresh, ' + data.name + '!');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = redirectDestination;
                }, 500);
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
                alert('Google Registration Error: ' + err.message);
            }
        }

        // Google Modal Controls
        function handleGoogleSignIn() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('googleAuthModal');
            if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
        }

        function closeGoogleModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('googleAuthModal');
            if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function submitCustomGoogleAccount() {
            const emailInput = document.getElementById('customGoogleEmail');
            const email = emailInput ? emailInput.value.trim() : '';
            if (!email) {
                alert('Please enter a Gmail address');
                return;
            }
            const name = email.split('@')[0];
            selectGoogleAccount(name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1), email);
        }

        async function selectGoogleAccount(name, email) {
            closeGoogleModal();
            try {
                const res = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/users/google-auth', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        email: email.trim(),
                        name: name,
                        picture: 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=' + encodeURIComponent(name) + '&background=0f7139&color=fff'
                    })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Google Sign-Up failed');

                localStorage.setItem('arshith_user', JSON.stringify(data));
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Welcome, ' + data.name + '!');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = redirectDestination;
                }, 500);
            } catch (err) {
                alert('Google Sign-Up Error: ' + err.message);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>

</html>

    <script>
        async function handleResetPassword(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const emailInput = document.getElementById('resetEmailInput');
            const submitBtn = document.getElementById('resetSubmitBtn');
            const successAlert = document.getElementById('resetSuccessAlert');
            const successText = document.getElementById('resetSuccessText');

            const email = emailInput ? emailInput.value.trim() : '';
            if (!email) return;

            // Loading state
            submitBtn.disabled = true;
            submitBtn.textContent = 'Sending email...';

            try {
                const response = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/users/forgot-password', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ email })
                });

                const data = await response.json();

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(data.message || 'Failed to send reset email');
                }

                submitBtn.textContent = 'Email Sent ✓';
                submitBtn.style.backgroundColor = '#0f7139';

                if (successText) {
                    successText.innerHTML = `
                        📧 An official password reset link has been sent to <strong>${email}</strong>!<br>
                        <span style="font-size: 13px; color: #475569; display: block; margin-top: 6px;">
                            Please check your Gmail inbox (or spam folder) and click the link in the email to reset your password.
                        </span>
                    `;
                }
                if (successAlert) {
                    successAlert.style.display = 'block';
                }

                if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                    showToast(`Password reset link sent to ${email}!`);
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Password reset error:', err);
                submitBtn.disabled = false;
                submitBtn.textContent = 'Submit';
                submitBtn.style.backgroundColor = '';

                if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                    showToast(err.message || 'Could not find account. Please check email.');
                } else {
                    alert(err.message || 'Could not find account. Please check email.');
                }
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>

</html>

    <script>
        function togglePasswordVisibility() {
            const pwdInput = document.getElementById('loginPassword');
            const eyeIcon = document.getElementById('eyeIcon');
            if (pwdInput.type === 'password') {
                pwdInput.type = 'text';
                eyeIcon.innerHTML = '<path d="M17.94 17.94A10.07 10.07 0 0 1 12 20c-7 0-11-8-11-8a18.45 18.45 0 0 1 5.06-5.94M9.9 4.24A9.12 9.12 0 0 1 12 4c7 0 11 8 11 8a18.5 18.5 0 0 1-2.16 3.19m-6.72-1.07a3 3 0 1 1-4.24-4.24"/><line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"/>';
            } else {
                pwdInput.type = 'password';
                eyeIcon.innerHTML = '<path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>';
            }
        }

        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const redirectDestination = urlParams.get('redirect') || '../../index.html';
        const noticeType = urlParams.get('notice');

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            const alertBox = document.getElementById('loginAlertBox');
            if (noticeType === 'checkout' && alertBox) {
                alertBox.innerText = '🔒 Please sign in to proceed to Checkout';
                alertBox.style.background = '#e8f5e9';
                alertBox.style.borderColor = '#0f7139';
                alertBox.style.color = '#0f7139';
                alertBox.style.display = 'block';
            }
            
            // Preserve redirect query param on register link
            if (redirectDestination) {
                const regLink = document.querySelector('.create-account-wrap a');
                if (regLink) {
                    regLink.href = `register.html?redirect=${encodeURIComponent(redirectDestination)}&notice=${encodeURIComponent(noticeType || '')}`;
                }
            }
        });

        async function handleLoginForm(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const email = document.getElementById('loginEmail').value.trim();
            const password = document.getElementById('loginPassword').value;
            const submitBtn = document.getElementById('loginSubmitBtn');
            const alertBox = document.getElementById('loginAlertBox');

            if (alertBox) alertBox.style.display = 'none';
            submitBtn.disabled = true;
            submitBtn.innerText = 'Signing in...';

            try {
                const res = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/users/login', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ email, password })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Invalid email or password');

                localStorage.setItem('arshith_user', JSON.stringify(data));
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Welcome back, ' + data.name + '!');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = redirectDestination;
                }, 600);
            } catch (err) {
                if (alertBox) {
                    alertBox.innerText = err.message;
                    alertBox.style.display = 'block';
                } else {
                    alert(err.message);
                }
                submitBtn.disabled = false;
                submitBtn.innerText = 'Sign in';
            }
        }

        // Google Identity Services Official Credential Handler
        function decodeJwtResponse(token) {
            var base64Url = token.split('.')[1];
            var base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
            var jsonPayload = decodeURIComponent(atob(base64).split('').map(function(c) {
                return '%' + ('00' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2);
            }).join(''));
            return JSON.parse(jsonPayload);
        }

        async function handleGoogleCredentialResponse(response) {
            try {
                const responsePayload = decodeJwtResponse(response.credential);
                console.log("Authenticated with Google:", responsePayload);

                const res = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/users/google-auth', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        email: responsePayload.email,
                        name: responsePayload.name,
                        picture: responsePayload.picture,
                        googleId: responsePayload.sub
                    })
                });

                const data = await res.json();
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Google login failed');

                localStorage.setItem('arshith_user', JSON.stringify(data));
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Welcome back, ' + data.name + '!');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = redirectDestination;
                }, 500);
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
                alert('Google Authentication Error: ' + err.message);
            }
        }

        // Google Modal Controls
        function handleGoogleSignIn() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('googleAuthModal');
            if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
        }

        function closeGoogleModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('googleAuthModal');
            if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function submitCustomGoogleAccount() {
            const emailInput = document.getElementById('customGoogleEmail');
            const email = emailInput ? emailInput.value.trim() : '';
            if (!email) {
                alert('Please enter a Gmail address');
                return;
            }
            const name = email.split('@')[0];
            selectGoogleAccount(name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1), email);
        }

        async function selectGoogleAccount(name, email) {
            closeGoogleModal();
            try {
                const res = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/users/google-auth', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        email: email.trim(),
                        name: name,
                        picture: 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=' + encodeURIComponent(name) + '&background=0f7139&color=fff'
                    })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Google Sign-In failed');

                localStorage.setItem('arshith_user', JSON.stringify(data));
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Welcome, ' + data.name + '!');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = redirectDestination;
                }, 500);
            } catch (err) {
                alert('Google Sign-In Error: ' + err.message);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>

</html>

                    <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px;">
                        <input type="email" id="customGoogleEmail" placeholder="yourname@gmail.com" style="flex: 1; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; outline: none;">

                <button type="button" onclick="closeGoogleModal()" style="background: none; border: none; color: #64748b; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;">Cancel</button>
            </div>
        </div>

    <!-- Script -->
    <script src="../../assets/js/script.js"></script>
    <script>
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const redirectDestination = urlParams.get('redirect') || '../../index.html';
        const noticeType = urlParams.get('notice');

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            const alertBox = document.getElementById('registerAlertBox');
            if (noticeType === 'checkout' && alertBox) {
                alertBox.innerText = '🔒 Create an account to proceed to Checkout';
                alertBox.style.background = '#e8f5e9';
                alertBox.style.borderColor = '#0f7139';
                alertBox.style.color = '#0f7139';
                alertBox.style.display = 'block';
            }
            
            // Preserve redirect query param on login link
            if (redirectDestination) {
                const loginLink = document.querySelector('.login-redirect-wrap a');
                if (loginLink) {
                    loginLink.href = `login.html?redirect=${encodeURIComponent(redirectDestination)}&notice=${encodeURIComponent(noticeType || '')}`;
                }
            }
        });

        async function handleRegisterForm(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const firstName = document.getElementById('regFirstName').value.trim();
            const lastName = document.getElementById('regLastName').value.trim();
            const email = document.getElementById('regEmail').value.trim();
            const phone = document.getElementById('regPhone').value.trim();
            const password = document.getElementById('regPassword').value;
            const submitBtn = document.getElementById('regSubmitBtn');
            const alertBox = document.getElementById('registerAlertBox');

            const fullName = (firstName + ' ' + lastName).trim();

            if (alertBox) alertBox.style.display = 'none';
            submitBtn.disabled = true;
            submitBtn.innerText = 'Creating account...';

            try {
                const res = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/users/register', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ name: fullName, email, password, phone })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Registration failed');

                localStorage.setItem('arshith_user', JSON.stringify(data));
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Account created! Welcome to Arshith Fresh.');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = redirectDestination;
                }, 600);
            } catch (err) {
                if (alertBox) {
                    alertBox.innerText = err.message;
                    alertBox.style.display = 'block';
                } else {
                    alert(err.message);
                }
                submitBtn.disabled = false;
                submitBtn.innerText = 'Create Account';
            }
        }

        // Google Identity Services Official Credential Handler
        function decodeJwtResponse(token) {
            var base64Url = token.split('.')[1];
            var base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
            var jsonPayload = decodeURIComponent(atob(base64).split('').map(function(c) {
                return '%' + ('00' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2);
            }).join(''));
            return JSON.parse(jsonPayload);
        }

        async function handleGoogleCredentialResponse(response) {
            try {
                const responsePayload = decodeJwtResponse(response.credential);
                console.log("Authenticated with Google:", responsePayload);

                const res = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/users/google-auth', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        email: responsePayload.email,
                        name: responsePayload.name,
                        picture: responsePayload.picture,
                        googleId: responsePayload.sub
                    })
                });

                const data = await res.json();
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Google registration failed');

                localStorage.setItem('arshith_user', JSON.stringify(data));
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Welcome to Arshith Fresh, ' + data.name + '!');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = redirectDestination;
                }, 500);
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
                alert('Google Registration Error: ' + err.message);
            }
        }

        // Google Modal Controls
        function handleGoogleSignIn() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('googleAuthModal');
            if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
        }

        function closeGoogleModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('googleAuthModal');
            if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function submitCustomGoogleAccount() {
            const emailInput = document.getElementById('customGoogleEmail');
            const email = emailInput ? emailInput.value.trim() : '';
            if (!email) {
                alert('Please enter a Gmail address');
                return;
            }
            const name = email.split('@')[0];
            selectGoogleAccount(name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1), email);
        }

        async function selectGoogleAccount(name, email) {
            closeGoogleModal();
            try {
                const res = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/users/google-auth', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        email: email.trim(),
                        name: name,
                        picture: 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=' + encodeURIComponent(name) + '&background=0f7139&color=fff'
                    })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Google Sign-Up failed');

                localStorage.setItem('arshith_user', JSON.stringify(data));
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Welcome, ' + data.name + '!');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = redirectDestination;
                }, 500);
            } catch (err) {
                alert('Google Sign-Up Error: ' + err.message);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>

</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Set New Password | Arshith Fresh</title>
    <meta name="description" content="Choose a new secure password for your Arshith Fresh account.">

    <!-- Google Fonts -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@700;800;900&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <!-- Stylesheet -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../assets/css/style.css?v=3.0">

        <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../assets/css/auth.css">
</head>

<body>

    <!-- Header / Navigation -->
    <header class="main-header">
        <div class="header-container">
            <div class="header-logo">
                <a href="../../index.html">
                    <img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0858/0772/6869/files/Arshithlogo111.jpg?v=1755685028&width=600"
                        alt="Arshith Fresh Logo" class="logo-img">
                </a>
            </div>

            <nav class="desktop-nav">
                <ul class="nav-links">
                    <li><a href="../../index.html">Home</a></li>
                    <li><a href="../collections.html?category=all">Collections</a></li>
                    <li><a href="login.html">Login</a></li>
                </ul>
            </nav>
        </div>
    </header>

    <!-- Main Reset Password Content -->
    <main class="reset-password-section">
        <h1 class="reset-password-heading">Set New Password</h1>
        <p class="reset-password-subtitle">Please enter your new password below</p>

        <form class="reset-password-form" id="setNewPasswordForm" onsubmit="handleSetNewPassword(event)">

            <div id="resetSuccessAlert" class="reset-alert-success">
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" style="vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 8px; flex-shrink: 0;">
                    <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"></path>
                    <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"></polyline>
                </svg>
                <span id="resetSuccessText">Password updated successfully! Redirecting to login...</span>
            </div>

            <div id="resetErrorAlert" class="reset-alert-error">
                <span id="resetErrorText">Invalid request.</span>
            </div>

            <div class="form-field-wrapper">
                <input type="password" id="newPassword" placeholder="New Password (min 6 chars)" required minlength="6" class="reset-input-control" aria-label="New Password">
                <button type="button" class="password-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleVisibility('newPassword', this)" aria-label="Toggle password visibility">
                    <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>
                </button>
            </div>

            <div class="form-field-wrapper">
                <input type="password" id="confirmPassword" placeholder="Confirm New Password" required minlength="6" class="reset-input-control" aria-label="Confirm New Password">
                <button type="button" class="password-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleVisibility('confirmPassword', this)" aria-label="Toggle password visibility">
                    <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>
                </button>
            </div>

            <div class="reset-btn-wrap">
                <button type="submit" id="savePasswordBtn" class="reset-submit-btn">Update Password</button>
            </div>

            <div class="cancel-redirect-wrap">
                <a href="login.html">Back to Login</a>
            </div>

        </form>
    </main>

    <!-- Footer -->
    <footer class="main-footer">
        <div class="footer-bottom" style="text-align: center; padding: 24px;">
            <p class="copyright-text">© 2025 Arshith Fresh India Pvt.Ltd. All rights reserved.</p>
        </div>
    </footer>

    <!-- Script -->
    <script src="../../assets/js/script.js"></script>
    <script>
        function toggleVisibility(inputId, btn) {
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            if (input.type === 'password') {
                input.type = 'text';
                btn.innerHTML = '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M17.94 17.94A10.07 10.07 0 0 1 12 20c-7 0-11-8-11-8a18.45 18.45 0 0 1 5.06-5.94M9.9 4.24A9.12 9.12 0 0 1 12 4c7 0 11 8 11 8a18.5 18.5 0 0 1-2.16 3.19m-6.72-1.07a3 3 0 1 1-4.24-4.24"/><line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"/></svg>';
            } else {
                input.type = 'password';
                btn.innerHTML = '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>';
            }
        }

        // Get reset token from URL query params
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const token = urlParams.get('token');

        if (!token) {
            const errorAlert = document.getElementById('resetErrorAlert');
            const errorText = document.getElementById('resetErrorText');
            if (errorAlert && errorText) {
                errorText.innerHTML = 'No reset token found. Please request a new password reset link from the <a href="forgot-password.html" style="text-decoration:underline; font-weight:600;">Forgot Password page</a>.';
                errorAlert.style.display = 'block';
            }
            document.getElementById('savePasswordBtn').disabled = true;
        }

        async function handleSetNewPassword(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const password = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
            const confirmPassword = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;
            const saveBtn = document.getElementById('savePasswordBtn');
            const errorAlert = document.getElementById('resetErrorAlert');
            const errorText = document.getElementById('resetErrorText');
            const successAlert = document.getElementById('resetSuccessAlert');

            errorAlert.style.display = 'none';

            if (password !== confirmPassword) {
                errorText.textContent = 'Passwords do not match. Please re-enter.';
                errorAlert.style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }

            if (password.length < 6) {
                errorText.textContent = 'Password must be at least 6 characters.';
                errorAlert.style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }

            saveBtn.disabled = true;
            saveBtn.textContent = 'Updating...';

            try {
                const response = await fetch(`http://localhost:5000/api/users/reset-password/${token}`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ password })
                });

                const data = await response.json();

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(data.message || 'Failed to reset password');
                }

                saveBtn.textContent = 'Saved ✓';
                saveBtn.style.backgroundColor = '#278d43';
                successAlert.style.display = 'flex';

                if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                    showToast('Password updated successfully! Redirecting...');
                }

                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = 'login.html';
                }, 1500);
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
                saveBtn.disabled = false;
                saveBtn.textContent = 'Update Password';
                errorText.textContent = err.message || 'Error updating password. Please try again.';
                errorAlert.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>

</html>

    <script>
        function renderCartPage() {
            const container = document.getElementById("cartPageContainer");
            if (!container) return;

            if (CART_ITEMS.length === 0) {
                // IMAGE 2: EMPTY CART STATE
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="empty-cart-page-view">
                        <h1 class="cart-empty-title">Your cart is empty</h1>
                        <a href="collections.html?category=all" class="continue-shopping-btn">Continue shopping</a>
                        
                        <div class="cart-account-prompt">
                            <h2 class="account-prompt-heading">Have an account?</h2>
                            <p class="account-prompt-sub"><a href="auth/login.html" class="cart-login-link">Log in</a> to check out faster.</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            // IMAGE 3: CART WITH ITEMS STATE
            const subtotal = CART_ITEMS.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.price * item.quantity), 0);

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div class="cart-page-header">
                    <h1 class="cart-main-title">Your cart</h1>
                    <a href="collections.html?category=all" class="continue-shopping-link">Continue shopping</a>
                </div>

                <div class="cart-table-wrapper">
                    <div class="cart-table-header">
                        <span class="col-product">PRODUCT</span>
                        <span class="col-quantity">QUANTITY</span>
                        <span class="col-total">TOTAL</span>
                    </div>

                    <div class="cart-items-rows">
                        ${CART_ITEMS.map((item, index) => {
                            const itemTotal = (item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2);
                            return `
                                <div class="cart-row-item">
                                    <div class="cart-col-product">
                                        <img src="${item.image || 'https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0858/0772/6869/files/4_6d56df69-1c9f-4f05-b1a7-ca631fc7b9aa.png'}" alt="${item.title}" class="cart-product-img">
                                        <div class="cart-product-details">
                                            <h3 class="cart-item-title">${item.title}</h3>
                                            <div class="cart-item-price">Rs. ${item.price.toFixed(2)}</div>
                                            <div class="cart-item-weight">Weight: ${item.weight || '250g'}</div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>

                                    <div class="cart-col-quantity">
                                        <div class="cart-qty-box">
                                            <button class="qty-control-btn" onclick="updateCartQuantity(${index}, ${item.quantity - 1}); renderCartPage();">&minus;</button>
                                            <span class="qty-num">${item.quantity}</span>
                                            <button class="qty-control-btn" onclick="updateCartQuantity(${index}, ${item.quantity + 1}); renderCartPage();">+</button>
                                        </div>
                                        <button class="cart-trash-btn" onclick="removeFromCart(${index}); renderCartPage();" title="Remove item" aria-label="Remove item">
                                            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0f7139" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                                                <polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"></polyline>
                                                <path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"></path>
                                            </svg>
                                        </button>
                                    </div>

                                    <div class="cart-col-total">
                                        <span class="cart-item-total-price">Rs. ${itemTotal}</span>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            `;
                        }).join("")}
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="cart-summary-section">
                    <div class="cart-summary-box">
                        <div class="estimated-total-row">
                        <p class="cart-tax-notice">Taxes included. Discounts and shipping calculated at checkout.</p>
                        <button class="cart-checkout-btn" onclick="handleCartCheckout()">Check out</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function handleCartCheckout() {
            window.location.href = "checkout.html";
        }

        function openCheckoutModal() {
            window.location.href = "checkout.html";
        }

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            renderCartPage();
        });
    </script>
</body>

</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Checkout | Arshith Fresh</title>
    <meta name="description" content="Secure Checkout - Arshith Fresh">

    <!-- Google Fonts -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <!-- Stylesheet -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../assets/css/style.css?v=3.0">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../assets/css/cart.css">

    <!-- Razorpay Standard Checkout SDK -->
    <script src="https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js"></script>

    <style>
        .payment-option-card {
            border: 1.5px solid #e5e7eb;
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .payment-option-card.selected {
            border-color: #0f7139;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #0f7139;
            background-color: #fbfdfb;
        }
        .payment-option-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 14px 16px;
            background: #ffffff;
        }
        .payment-option-left {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }
        .payment-radio-circle {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid #9ca3af;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }
        .payment-option-card.selected .payment-radio-circle {
            border-color: #0f7139;
        }
        .payment-radio-inner {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background-color: transparent;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }
        .payment-option-card.selected .payment-radio-inner {
            background-color: #0f7139;
        }
        .payment-name {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #1f2937;
        }
        .payment-option-body {
            padding: 14px 16px;
            background: #f9fafb;
            border-top: 1px solid #f3f4f6;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: #4b5563;
            line-height: 1.5;
            display: none;
        }
        .payment-option-card.selected .payment-option-body {
            display: block;
        }
        .pay-now-btn:disabled {
            background-color: #9ca3af !important;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }
        .order-success-modal {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 99999;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }
        .order-success-modal.show {
            opacity: 1;
            pointer-events: auto;
        }
        .order-success-box {
            background: #ffffff;
            border-radius: 12px;
            max-width: 480px;
            width: 90%;
            padding: 32px 24px;
            text-align: center;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 10px 10px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
            animation: slideUp 0.3s ease;
        }
        @keyframes slideUp {
            from { transform: translateY(20px); opacity: 0; }
            to { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
        }
        .success-icon-circle {
            width: 64px;
            height: 64px;
            background: #dcfce7;
            color: #166534;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 32px;
            margin: 0 auto 16px;
        }
        .success-title {
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #111827;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        .success-desc {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #6b7280;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .order-info-pill {
            background: #f3f4f6;
            padding: 10px 16px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: #374151;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            text-align: left;
        }
        .order-info-pill div {
            margin: 4px 0;
        }
        .btn-continue-store {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 100%;
            background: #0f7139;
            color: #ffffff;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 15px;
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }
        .btn-continue-store:hover {
            background: #0b3718;
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>

    <!-- TOP HEADER BAR -->
    <header class="checkout-top-bar">
        <a href="../index.html">
            <img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0858/0772/6869/files/Arshithlogo111.jpg?v=1755685028&width=600" alt="Arshith Fresh Logo" class="checkout-header-logo-img">

                    <path d="M6 2L3 6v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V6l-3-4z"></path>
                    <line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"></line>

                </svg>
                <span id="checkoutTopCartCount" class="cart-badge-num">0</span>

    </header>

    <!-- MAIN TWO COLUMN GRID -->
    <div class="checkout-main-grid">

        <div class="checkout-form-pane">
            
            <form id="checkoutForm" onsubmit="handlePlaceOrder(event)">
                
                <!-- CONTACT SECTION -->
                <div class="checkout-section-title">

                    </span>
                </div>

                    <input type="text" placeholder="Email or mobile phone number" required class="form-input-control" id="contactInput">
                    <span class="input-icon-right">ⓘ</span>
                </div>

                <label class="checkbox-row">
                    <input type="checkbox" checked style="accent-color: #0f7139;" id="newsCheckbox">
                    <span>Email me with news and offers</span>
                </label>

                <!-- DELIVERY SECTION -->
                <div class="checkout-section-title" style="margin-top: 24px;">
                    <span>Delivery</span>
                </div>

                <div style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
                    <select class="form-select-control" id="countrySelect">
                        <option value="India" selected>India</option>
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div class="dual-inputs-grid">
                    <input type="text" placeholder="First name" required class="form-input-control" id="firstNameInput">
                    <input type="text" placeholder="Last name" required class="form-input-control" id="lastNameInput">
                </div>

                <div class="input-icon-wrap" style="margin-top: 12px;">
                    <input type="text" placeholder="Address" required class="form-input-control" id="addressInput">
                    <span class="input-icon-right">🔍</span>
                </div>

                <div style="margin-top: 12px;">
                    <input type="text" placeholder="Apartment, suite, etc. (optional)" class="form-input-control" id="apartmentInput">
                </div>

                <div class="triple-inputs-grid">
                    <input type="text" placeholder="City" required class="form-input-control" id="cityInput">
                    <select class="form-select-control" id="stateSelect">
                        <option value="Karnataka" selected>Karnataka</option>
                        <option value="Andhra Pradesh">Andhra Pradesh</option>
                        <option value="Telangana">Telangana</option>
                        <option value="Tamil Nadu">Tamil Nadu</option>
                        <option value="Maharashtra">Maharashtra</option>
                        <option value="Delhi">Delhi</option>
                        <option value="Gujarat">Gujarat</option>
                        <option value="Kerala">Kerala</option>
                        <option value="Other">Other</option>
                    </select>
                    <input type="text" placeholder="PIN code" required class="form-input-control" id="pinCodeInput">
                </div>

                <div class="input-icon-wrap" style="margin-top: 12px;">
                    <input type="tel" placeholder="Phone" required class="form-input-control" id="phoneInput">
                    <span class="input-icon-right">ⓘ</span>
                </div>

                <label class="checkbox-row" style="margin-top: 16px;">
                    <input type="checkbox" style="accent-color: #0f7139;" checked id="saveInfoCheckbox">
                    <span>Save this information for next time</span>
                </label>


                <!-- PAYMENT SECTION -->
                <div class="checkout-section-title" style="margin-top: 32px;">
                    <span>Payment Method</span>
                </div>
                <div style="font-size: 13px; color: #6b7280; margin-bottom: 12px;">
                    All transactions are 100% secure, encrypted, and backed by Razorpay.
                </div>

                <!-- Razorpay Option -->
                <div class="payment-option-card selected" id="cardRazorpay" onclick="selectPaymentMethod('Razorpay')">
                    <div class="payment-option-header">
                        <div class="payment-option-left">
                            <div class="payment-radio-circle">
                                <div class="payment-radio-inner"></div>
                            </div>
                            <span class="payment-name">Razorpay Secure (UPI, Cards, NetBanking, Wallets)</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="payment-badges" style="display: flex; gap: 4px; align-items: center;">
                            <span style="font-size: 10px; background: #5f259f; color: #fff; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: bold;">UPI</span>
                            <span style="font-size: 10px; background: #1a1f71; color: #fff; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: bold;">VISA</span>
                            <span style="font-size: 10px; background: #eb001b; color: #fff; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: bold;">MC</span>
                            <span class="badge-more" style="font-size: 10px; background: #e5e7eb; color: #374151; padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px;">+18</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="payment-option-body">

                <!-- Cash on Delivery Option -->
                <div class="payment-option-card" id="cardCOD" onclick="selectPaymentMethod('COD')">
