        async function cancelUserOrder(orderId) {
            if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to cancel this order? All items in this order will be returned to store inventory.')) {
                return;
            }

            try {
                const res = await fetch(`http://localhost:5000/api/orders/${orderId}/cancel`, {
                    method: 'PUT',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
                });

                const data = await res.json();
                if (res.ok) {
                    alert('Order cancelled successfully! All items have been returned to store inventory.');
                    // Update local storage cache
                    try {
                        const localOrders = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('arshith_user_orders')) || [];
                        const idx = localOrders.findIndex(o => String(o._id) === String(orderId));
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            localOrders[idx].status = 'Cancelled';
                            localStorage.setItem('arshith_user_orders', JSON.stringify(localOrders));
                        }
                    } catch (e) {}
                    loadUserProfile();
                } else {
                    alert(data.message || 'Failed to cancel order.');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                alert('Error cancelling order: ' + err.message);
            }
        }

        function switchTab(tabId, btn) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));

            const target = document.getElementById(`tab-${tabId}`);
            if (target) target.classList.add('active');
            if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
        }

        async function handleUpdateProfile(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const btn = document.getElementById('saveProfileBtn');
            const alertBox = document.getElementById('saveSuccessAlert');

            const nameVal = document.getElementById('profileName').value.trim();
            const phoneVal = document.getElementById('profilePhone').value.trim();
            const streetVal = document.getElementById('profileStreet').value.trim();
            const cityVal = document.getElementById('profileCity').value.trim();
            const postalCodeVal = document.getElementById('profilePostalCode').value.trim();

            const updatedData = {
                name: nameVal || (currentUser ? currentUser.name : 'Valued Customer'),
                phone: phoneVal,
                street: streetVal,
                city: cityVal,
                postalCode: postalCodeVal
            };

            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.textContent = 'Saving...';

            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/users/profile/${currentUser._id}`, {
                    method: 'PUT',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(updatedData)
                });

                let data = null;
                try { data = await response.json(); } catch(err) {}

                if (response.ok && data) {
                    currentUser = { ...currentUser, ...data };
                } else {
                    currentUser = { ...currentUser, ...updatedData };
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('API save error, persisting locally:', err);
                currentUser = { ...currentUser, ...updatedData };
            } finally {
                localStorage.setItem('arshith_user', JSON.stringify(currentUser));
                hasFormBeenPopulated = true;

                if (document.getElementById('userGreeting')) {
                    document.getElementById('userGreeting').textContent = `Hello, ${currentUser.name || 'Valued Customer'}`;
                }
                if (document.getElementById('userAvatar')) {
                    document.getElementById('userAvatar').textContent = (currentUser.name || 'U').charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                }

                if (alertBox) {
                    alertBox.style.display = 'flex';
                    setTimeout(() => { alertBox.style.display = 'none'; }, 3500);
                }

                if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                    showToast('Profile details updated successfully!');
                }

                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = 'Save Changes';
            }
        }

        async function handleChangePassword(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const pass = document.getElementById('newPass').value;
            const confirmPass = document.getElementById('confirmNewPass').value;
            const btn = document.getElementById('savePasswordBtn');
            const alertBox = document.getElementById('passwordSuccessAlert');

            if (pass !== confirmPass) {
                alert('Passwords do not match');
                return;
            }

            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.textContent = 'Updating...';

            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/users/change-password/${currentUser._id}`, {
                    method: 'PUT',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ currentPassword: pass, newPassword: pass })
                });

                const data = await response.json();

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(data.message || 'Failed to update password');
                }

                document.getElementById('passwordForm').reset();
                if (alertBox) {
                    alertBox.style.display = 'flex';
                    setTimeout(() => { alertBox.style.display = 'none'; }, 3500);
                }

                if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                    showToast('Password changed successfully!');
                }
            } finally {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = 'Update Password';
            }
        }

        // Live Rating & Description Popup Modal Logic (Above the Money)
        let currentRatingOrderId = '';
        let currentRatingItemIdx = '';
        let currentRatingProductName = '';
        let currentRatingProductId = '';
        let currentSelectedLiveStars = 5;

        const starLabels = {
            5: '⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 Stars — Excellent / Loved it!',
            4: '⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4 Stars — Very Good / High Quality',
            3: '⭐⭐⭐ 3 Stars — Good / Average Quality',
            2: '⭐⭐ 2 Stars — Below Average',
            1: '⭐ 1 Star — Poor / Disappointed'
        };

        window.openLiveRatingPopup = function(orderId, itemIdx, productName, productImg, productPrice, productId) {
            currentRatingOrderId = orderId;
            currentRatingItemIdx = itemIdx;
            currentRatingProductName = productName || 'Fresh Product';
            currentRatingProductId = productId || '';
            currentSelectedLiveStars = 5;

            const modal = document.getElementById('liveRatingPopupModal');
            const titleEl = document.getElementById('popupProdTitle');
            const imgEl = document.getElementById('popupProdImg');
            const priceEl = document.getElementById('popupProdPrice');
            const authorInput = document.getElementById('popupReviewerName');

            if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = currentRatingProductName;
            if (imgEl && productImg) imgEl.src = productImg;
            if (priceEl) priceEl.textContent = '\u20b9' + productPrice;

            if (authorInput && currentUser && currentUser.name) {
                authorInput.value = currentUser.name;
            }

            // Check if already rated before
            const itemKey = `rating_${orderId}_${itemIdx}`;
            try {
                const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('arshith_product_ratings') || '{}');
                if (stored[itemKey]) {
                    currentSelectedLiveStars = stored[itemKey].rating || 5;
                    const descEl = document.getElementById('popupReviewDescription');
                    if (descEl && stored[itemKey].comment) descEl.value = stored[itemKey].comment;
                }
            } catch(e) {}

            updateLiveStarDisplay(currentSelectedLiveStars);

            if (modal) {
                modal.style.display = 'flex';
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            }
        };

        window.closeLiveRatingPopup = function() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('liveRatingPopupModal');
            if (modal) {
                modal.style.display = 'none';
                document.body.style.overflow = '';
            }
        };

        window.setLiveStarRating = function(starVal) {
            currentSelectedLiveStars = Number(starVal);
            updateLiveStarDisplay(currentSelectedLiveStars);
        };

        function updateLiveStarDisplay(stars) {
            const starBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.interactive-star-btn');
            starBtns.forEach((btn, idx) => {
                const val = idx + 1;
                if (val <= stars) {
                    btn.style.color = '#f59e0b';
                    btn.textContent = '★';
                } else {
                    btn.style.color = '#cbd5e1';
                    btn.textContent = '☆';
                }
            });

            const lbl = document.getElementById('liveStarSelectedLabel');
            if (lbl) lbl.textContent = starLabels[stars] || `${stars} Stars`;

            const dropdown = document.getElementById('popupRatingDropdown');
            if (dropdown) dropdown.value = String(stars);
        }

        window.handleLiveRatingSubmit = async function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const btn = document.getElementById('submitLiveRatingBtn');
            if (btn) {
                btn.disabled = true;
                btn.textContent = 'Saving Rating...';
            }

            const rating = currentSelectedLiveStars || Number(document.getElementById('popupRatingDropdown').value) || 5;
            const name = (document.getElementById('popupReviewerName').value || '').trim();
            const comment = (document.getElementById('popupReviewDescription').value || '').trim();
            const email = (currentUser && currentUser.email) ? currentUser.email : 'customer@arshithfresh.com';

            if (!comment) {
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Please write a short feedback before submitting.');
                if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Submit Rating ✨'; }
                return;
            }

            const itemKey = `rating_${currentRatingOrderId}_${currentRatingItemIdx}`;

            try {
                // 1. Save locally (keyed by itemKey AND by productId for cross-page sync)
                const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('arshith_product_ratings') || '{}');
                const reviewData = {
                    orderId: currentRatingOrderId,
                    productId: currentRatingProductId,
                    productName: currentRatingProductName,
                    rating,
                    title: name ? `Review by ${name}` : 'Customer Review',
                    comment,
                    name,
                    email,
                    verifiedPurchase: true,
                    date: new Date().toISOString()
                };
                stored[itemKey] = reviewData;
                // Also key by productId so product page can look it up
                if (currentRatingProductId) {
                    stored[`pid_${currentRatingProductId}`] = reviewData;
                }
                localStorage.setItem('arshith_product_ratings', JSON.stringify(stored));

                // 2. POST to real /api/reviews backend endpoint
                try {
                    const payload = {
                        productId: currentRatingProductId || currentRatingProductName,
                        productName: currentRatingProductName,
                        customerName: name || 'Verified Customer',
                        customerEmail: email,
                        rating: Number(rating),
                        title: name ? `Review by ${name}` : 'Customer Review',
                        comment,
                        verifiedPurchase: true,
                        images: []
                    };
                    const apiRes = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/reviews', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                    });
                    // If backend saved successfully, store the returned _id for editing later
                    if (apiRes.ok) {
                        const saved = await apiRes.json();
                        if (saved && saved._id && stored[itemKey]) {
                            stored[itemKey].backendId = saved._id;
                            if (currentRatingProductId && stored[`pid_${currentRatingProductId}`]) {
                                stored[`pid_${currentRatingProductId}`].backendId = saved._id;
                            }
                            localStorage.setItem('arshith_product_ratings', JSON.stringify(stored));
                        }
                    }
                } catch(apiErr) {
                    console.warn('Backend review save failed, review saved locally:', apiErr);
                }

                if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                    showToast('\u2728 Thank you! Your ' + rating + '-star review has been submitted and will appear on the product page.');
                } else {
                    alert('Thank you for your review! It will appear on the product page.');
                }

                // 3. Update the trigger button above the money in real time
                const rateTriggerBtn = document.getElementById(`rateBtn_${itemKey}`);
                if (rateTriggerBtn) {
                    rateTriggerBtn.innerHTML = '\u2b50 Rated ' + rating + '\u2605';
                    rateTriggerBtn.style.background = '#ecfdf5';
                    rateTriggerBtn.style.color = '#047857';
                    rateTriggerBtn.style.borderColor = '#86efac';
                }

                closeLiveRatingPopup();
            } catch (err) {
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                    showToast('Could not save rating. Please try again.');
                }
            } finally {
                if (btn) {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.textContent = 'Submit Rating \u2728';
                }
            }
        };

        function handleLogout() {
            localStorage.removeItem('arshith_user');
            sessionStorage.clear();

            if (window.google && google.accounts && google.accounts.id) {
                try {
                    google.accounts.id.disableAutoSelect();
                } catch (err) {}
            }

            if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                showToast('Logged out successfully');
            }
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.location.href = '../index.html';
            }, 400);
        }
    </script>

    <!-- LIVE RATING & DESCRIPTION POPUP MODAL (ABOVE MONEY TRIGGER) -->
    <div id="liveRatingPopupModal" style="display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(15,23,42,0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); z-index: 99999; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px;">
        <div style="background: #ffffff; border-radius: 18px; width: 100%; max-width: 500px; padding: 28px 32px; box-shadow: 0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); position: relative; animation: fadeInModal 0.25s ease-out; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
            
            <!-- Modal Header -->
            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 18px;">
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;">
                    <img id="popupProdImg" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0858/0772/6869/collections/spice_200x200_crop_center.png?v=1746963495" style="width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 10px; object-fit: cover; border: 1.5px solid #e2e8f0; background: #fafbfc;">
                    <div>

                <!-- Live Interactive Star Rating Row -->

                        <span class="interactive-star-btn" onclick="setLiveStarRating(2)" style="color: #f59e0b; transition: transform 0.15s ease;" onmouseover="this.style.transform='scale(1.25)'" onmouseout="this.style.transform='scale(1)'">★</span>
                        <span class="interactive-star-btn" onclick="setLiveStarRating(3)" style="color: #f59e0b; transition: transform 0.15s ease;" onmouseover="this.style.transform='scale(1.25)'" onmouseout="this.style.transform='scale(1)'">★</span>
                        <span class="interactive-star-btn" onclick="setLiveStarRating(4)" style="color: #f59e0b; transition: transform 0.15s ease;" onmouseover="this.style.transform='scale(1.25)'" onmouseout="this.style.transform='scale(1)'">★</span>
                        <span class="interactive-star-btn" onclick="setLiveStarRating(5)" style="color: #f59e0b; transition: transform 0.15s ease;" onmouseover="this.style.transform='scale(1.25)'" onmouseout="this.style.transform='scale(1)'">★</span>
                    </div>

                    <div id="liveStarSelectedLabel" style="font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f7139;">⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 Stars — Excellent / Loved it!</div>

                <div style="margin-bottom: 16px;">
                    <label style="display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #334155; margin-bottom: 6px;">Or Choose Rating from Dropdown *</label>
                    <select id="popupRatingDropdown" onchange="setLiveStarRating(this.value)" required style="width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1.5px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; outline: none;">

                        <option value="4">⭐⭐⭐⭐ — 4 Stars (Very Good / High Quality)</option>
                        <option value="3">⭐⭐⭐ — 3 Stars (Good / Average Quality)</option>
